adjustGiftCardBalance.description: Posts a relative correction with a typed reason and separate administrative authority. Corrections cannot consume reserved funds, exceed funding limits, or replace linked refunds and purchase reversals. expected_version fences the gift card version.

advanceOnboarding.description: Submits whatever the caller currently knows, re-evaluates onboarding, reconciles onboarding requirements, and returns the next step in the consolidated onboarding state machine. Send an empty JSON object when the current next_step only asks to refresh onboarding requirements. An onboarding session is limited to the merchant's default sandbox unless sandbox_id in the JSON body names another sandbox of the same merchant. Live onboarding requires a live API key.

applyOrderDiscount.description: Applies a promotion-backed or manual discount to an order. Checkout-authenticated buyers must provide a promotion code; resource IDs and manual discounts require merchant authentication.

applyOrderGiftCard.description: Selects a gift card by its current code and returns masked selections and an unreserved estimate. No value is held or debited. Optional expected_version must match the order version returned by the last read. An order may select at most 20 gift cards. Gift card value cannot pay for subscription orders. Retry a lost response with the same Idempotency-Key to recover the original selection result.

approvePaymentReview.description: Approves the payment and closes the review with `closed_reason: approved`. Approving never captures: capture a manual-capture payment yourself before `authorization_expires_at`. Approving a review you already approved returns it unchanged.

assignToUnconfiguredDeliveryProfile.description: Assigns this active delivery profile to physical product variants and bundle components that do not have a delivery profile.

authorizePartnerInstall.description: Starts a partner app install in the merchant's browser. Flint validates the request, then redirects to Flint's consent screen, where the merchant signs in, chooses a merchant, and approves or denies the requested permissions. Flint then redirects to redirect_uri with code, state, and mode, or with an OAuth error. Request errors found before consent also redirect with an OAuth error once client_id and redirect_uri are validated. Unknown or inactive clients and missing or unregistered redirect URIs return the Flint error envelope. Flint ignores unrecognized parameters.

cancelGiftCardNotification.description: Cancels a notification before sending starts or after confirmed failure. A sending or unconfirmed notification cannot be canceled. Gift card value is preserved.

cancelGiftCardRedemption.description: Releases an uncaptured standalone reservation without posting a debit or refund. Flint order reservations cannot be released while a processor outcome is unresolved. expected_version fences the redemption version.

cancelInvoicePaymentAttempt.description: Cancels an active invoice payment attempt and its payment intent. A processing ACH debit can be canceled only until the payment processor sends it to the bank; after that the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress and the attempt stays processing. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key. Accepts an empty body or {}.

cancelMeReturn.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Cancel a Return before any merchandise or value work commits. Cancellation is refused once a receipt, inspection, disposition, or resolution exists.

cancelMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Cancels a subscription and records who asked, why, and when in cancellation_details. With cancel_immediately: true it ends now. Otherwise, trialing ends at trial_end_at, active at current_period_end_at (or now when a renewal delivery hold has expired), and past_due at next_retry_at instead of that retry. Scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at require cancel_immediately: true or return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason period_end_unavailable. Read scheduled_cancel_at for the scheduled end time. A buyer's cancellation follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

cancelOrderPayment.description: Cancels an unsettled order-owned payment leg. A leg in an active payment attempt requires the matching order_payment_attempt_id. Canceling an authorization releases the payment lock and attempt-owned holds; a staged or declined leg with no active attempt can be canceled without an attempt ID.

cancelOrderPaymentAttempt.description: Cancels an active order payment attempt, its unsettled payment legs, and its attempt-owned holds.

cancelPaymentIntent.description: Cancels a standalone or order-owned payment intent. Read supported_actions for the actions its stored state accepts. Canceling a hold moves all of capturable_money to released_money, and nothing is charged. A processing payment intent returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress; refund a succeeded one instead. Flint derives the owning order payment attempt. A leg held by an active order payment attempt may be refused. Omitted cancellation_reason stays absent. A fresh request for a canceled or expired payment returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a same-key retry replays or recovers its original result. A checkout credential can cancel only its own order leg, with requested_by_customer or abandoned when a reason is supplied.

cancelPayout.description: Cancels an eligible payout before it leaves Flint-controlled processing and returns the resulting payout.

cancelReturn.description: Cancel a Return before any merchandise or value work commits. Cancellation is refused once a receipt, inspection, disposition, or resolution exists.

cancelReturnDisposition.description: Cancel a disposition that has not started its inventory effect. Cancellation is refused once the effect is processing.

cancelReturnLineItem.description: Cancel approved quantity on a Return line item. Quantity already received, inspected, dispositioned, or reserved by a resolution, including a failed one, cannot be canceled, and the conflict response names what is blocking it. Omit handback_quantity to lower the expected handback only as far as the canceled quantity requires. An explicit value cannot leave more merchandise expected than the remaining approved quantity.

cancelReturnResolution.description: Cancel a resolution and release the line value it reserved. A failed resolution can be canceled only when it never created a Refund, PaymentIntent, or Order, or when it is an unpaid exchange. Effects that already succeeded are undone with a compensating correction instead.

cancelSubscription.description: Cancels a subscription and records who asked, why, and when in cancellation_details. With cancel_immediately: true it ends now. Otherwise, trialing ends at trial_end_at, active at current_period_end_at (or now when a renewal delivery hold has expired), and past_due at next_retry_at instead of that retry. Scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at require cancel_immediately: true or return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason period_end_unavailable. Read scheduled_cancel_at for the scheduled end time. A buyer's cancellation follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

captureGiftCardRedemption.description: Posts the full reserved amount before the manual reservation expires. Capturing and expiry use the same concurrency fence. Flint order reservations are resolved by their payment attempt and cannot be captured through this standalone operation. expected_version fences the redemption version.

captureOrderPayment.description: Captures an active payment authorization for an order and updates the order payment lifecycle.

capturePaymentIntent.description: Captures a standalone or order-owned payment intent in requires_capture. Omit amount_money to capture all of capturable_money, or send a smaller amount for a partial capture. Flint releases the uncaptured remainder in the same request, and a payment intent can be captured only once. amount_money on the payment intent keeps the requested amount; captured_money and released_money record the result. Affirm payments can only be captured in full. Flint derives the owning order payment attempt; order_payment_attempt_id is not accepted. An expired authorization is refreshed before capture and refused with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status or authorization_expired. A fresh request for an already captured payment returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a same-key retry replays or recovers its original result.

cashOutGiftCard.description: Records cash that the merchant attests it paid to the cardholder. Flint does not send cash. The amount cannot exceed available value or consume payment reservations; cash_out_reference identifies the cash disbursement the merchant made outside Flint. expected_version fences the gift card version.

changeMeSubscriptionBillingInterval.description: Changes future renewals to an interval currently offered by the subscription plan or frozen offer. Requires a full buyer session, billing_interval, and billing_interval_count. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes.

changeMeSubscriptionDelivery.description: Saves an offered delivery method and destination for future renewals when buyer delivery changes are enabled. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. A paid shipment already in progress keeps its destination.

changeMeSubscriptionPaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Changes the subscription to an active payment method owned by the same customer. The payment method's usage must be off_session. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. A card whose setup hasn't finished returns 409 PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_READY. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key once setup finishes.

changeMeSubscriptionQuantity.description: Changes future renewals to a quantity currently offered by the subscription plan or frozen offer. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. Delivery eligibility is checked for the new quantity.

changeSubscriptionPaymentMethod.description: Changes the subscription to an active payment method owned by the same customer. The payment method's usage must be off_session. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. A card whose setup hasn't finished returns 409 PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_READY. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key once setup finishes.

changeSubscriptionPlan.description: Replaces the subscription's lines and recurring options with the active target plan's current terms. With billing_starts next_renewal, changes terms now without charging and keeps the current period and next billing date. With billing_starts now, charges a new period and credits unused paid item time after promotions; the plan changes only when payment succeeds. If the credit exceeds the new item charge, choose next_renewal. Omit interval and quantity to keep their current values; the target plan must offer them. Contract terms and existing recurring promotions are preserved. Requires Idempotency-Key; retry with the same key to recover the same result. Returns status 200 for a decline, with a closed unpaid order, failed order_payment_attempt, and unchanged subscription. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error and update the subscription payment method before trying again. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. After a confirmed CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION with billing_starts now, refresh the subscription and send a new Idempotency-Key. The buyer account cannot change plans.

checkDeliveryRateCallbackConnection.description: Sends a minimal signed probe to verify endpoint reachability and callback credentials without running a synthetic rate evaluation. The Idempotency-Key fingerprint includes the delivery_rate_callback_id path value and request body. A retry replays the original result even after the callback changes or is archived.

closeCheckoutSession.description: Closes an open checkout session before it naturally expires.

closeOrder.description: Closes an open order and stops further payment. Cancels pending discounts, releases their reservations, and recalculates totals; canceled discounts remain visible with status: "canceled" but no longer reduce the total. Unused order-owned payment intents are canceled. When collected money remains refundable, send collected_money_behavior: keep to close and keep it, or refund it first with POST /v1/refunds and order_id. Closing does not refund money; refunds remain available afterwards. Closing is blocked while payment collection is in progress. To complete a zero-balance order as paid, use POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay. closed_reason and closed_at record why and when the order closed. The request body is optional. Send expected_version to reject a mutation based on an outdated order read.

collectInvoice.description: Charges the invoice's saved payment method or the supplied saved payment method. This command requires a caller-chosen Idempotency-Key that is reused for retries of the same collection request.

completeFile.description: After PUT succeeds, complete the file to process its image. Returns the ready file; completing a ready file again returns it. Send no request body or {}. Completing before the bytes arrive returns FILE_NOT_UPLOADED and leaves the file awaiting_upload. Attach the returned file_id as images[].file_id before expires_at, 24 hours after processing. Completion requires the purpose's write scope, with the same merchant-wide branding and environment boundaries as createFile. Partner installs can upload commerce images but cannot upload merchant_logo or merchant_icon: those purposes return INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE with scope_requirement because merchants.profile.write is not grantable to installs. Idempotency is scoped to merchant, credential, environment, route, and file_id. A replay returns the original result; it does not extend upload or attachment deadlines. After a lost completion response, repeat this route with the same key and file_id.

completeReturn.description: Complete a Return whose completion_mode is manual. The call fails while completion_blockers is non-empty. Automatic Returns complete themselves when the final blocker clears.

confirmCheckoutSessionCustomerVerificati.description: Checks the code the buyer typed. A right code makes the checkout act for the customer with that email, and creates the customer, with a customer.created event, when none exists. The checkout can then save the buyer's card with save_payment_method on POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay, and list and pay with that customer's saved cards. The order's customer does not change until the payment succeeds. Only the checkout_auth_token in the response acts for that customer. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <checkout_auth_token> from then on. Every other credential for the session, including earlier checkout_auth_token values and hosted checkout links, keeps working for the checkout and acts for no customer, so it lists no saved cards and pays with none. A buyer who opens the link on another device confirms an email there to use them, and from then on only that device's new credential acts for a customer. If the response is lost after the code was accepted, the credential you sent still works. Send the same code again with it while the code is valid, which counts as another try and returns a new credential for the same customer, or request a new code. A wrong, expired, or replaced code returns CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID, and so does a used code once the checkout was confirmed again, any code after its 5th try, any code for an email past its limit on wrong tries, or a code whose email's customer changed its email or was deleted after the code was sent. If the checkout stops offering saved payment details before the code is confirmed, such as when the merchant turns them off, the request returns CUSTOMER_VERIFICATION_NOT_OFFERED. A credential that already acts for a customer gets CHECKOUT_CUSTOMER_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED, and confirming never replaces a customer the merchant named. Once the customer whose email the buyer confirmed changes that email or is deleted, the checkout acts for no customer, and the buyer can confirm the customer's new email or another one. A checkout opened from a checkout reminder link acts for no customer the buyer confirmed earlier, so its buyer confirms an email again. A texted code for saved details binds the checkout the same way, but the new credential opens only the cards saved with that number: it lists and pays with no card saved by email, and reads no customer details. A texted code checks once, so after a lost answer request a new code. A code for purpose confirm_saved_payment_method keeps the session's credential, so the response omits checkout_auth_token and carries payment_method_save on the checkout session. A texted code saves the card with the number when the number already opens the customer's saved details or the customer has none yet; otherwise payment_method_save.email_confirmation_required turns true, and an emailed code finishes the save. An emailed code alone saves the card by email. After success, a retry with the same Idempotency-Key and code returns the stored answer and credential to any credential of the session. After failure, a retry checks the code again and counts as another try.

confirmCustomerVerification.description: Confirms the Flint-sent code and returns a verification that can link guest purchases for its customer. A confirmed verification expires in 15 minutes and can be redeemed once.

confirmMeEmailChangeRequest.description: Confirms possession of the current and new email addresses, then atomically updates the customer account in the selected merchant environment. Omit current_email_code only when current_email_confirmation_required is false. A successful confirmation signs the buyer out everywhere at this store: it revokes every customer session, buyer access grant, and Flint-hosted account session for the customer, including the session that made this request. Sign the buyer in again with the new email.

confirmPaymentIntent.description: Confirms a standalone payment intent. For the first confirmation, send exactly one of stripe.confirmation_token, payment_source_token, or payment_method_id; without one, it returns FIELD_REQUIRED. After the buyer completes current_payment_action, call this route again with no body or {} to continue the same payment attempt. Flint confirms again only if the processor still requires it, and otherwise returns the current payment intent. Unverified fee fields are omitted. current_payment_action is null when no buyer action is needed. It can also be null while status is requires_action if Flint cannot produce the action yet; call confirm again with an empty body. Order-owned payment intents return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason order_owned and supported_actions; pay them through POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay using remediation.next_actions.

confirmReturnResolution.description: Confirm a proposed resolution and freeze its economic facts. Execution can remain pending behind line-qualified execution blockers.

createAPIKey.description: Creates a merchant-bound external API key. secret_key is returned only in the initial successful response and accepted idempotent replays of the same create request.

createCategory.description: Creates a reusable category. If handle is omitted, Flint derives it from the name and never changes it on rename.

createCheckoutSession.description: Creates a hosted or embedded checkout session for an order, quick-pay charge, or subscription plan signup. Creation never implicitly replaces an open order session. To replace one, send order_id with replace_checkout_session_id set to the expected current session; the compare-and-swap replacement and collection-lock transfer commit atomically.

createCheckoutSessionCustomerVerificatio.description: Sends a six-digit code to prove the buyer controls an email address or mobile phone number, so this checkout can save a card, use saved details, or confirm a saved card. Only the session's own checkout credential can call it. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same code request without sending another email or text. See the [headless checkout guide](https://developers.withflintpay.com/docs/guides/headless-checkout) for limits, sandbox codes, SMS copy, and what each answer reveals. To link guest purchases, use POST /v1/customer-verifications.

createCheckoutSessionDeliveryQuote.description: Creates an exact checkout-bound delivery quote without holding inventory.

createCheckoutSessionDeliverySelection.description: Atomically selects one option per choice group, replaces inventory holds, and recalculates checkout economics.

createCreditNote.description: Creates a draft credit note against an invoice that has been issued and not voided. Include line_items for initial corrections or omit them for an empty draft. The draft uses frozen invoice economics and the remaining pools shared by issued, non-void notes. Drafts reserve no credit. It receives a credit note number when issued.

createCreditNoteAllocation.description: Applies credit from an issued credit note to its invoice, reducing outstanding_money. The amount cannot exceed the credit note's available_money or the invoice's outstanding balance. Closing the balance with credit sets the invoice to paid when positive net collection remains, or credited when there is no positive net collection. Returns the allocation, the credit note, and the recomputed invoice together. An Idempotency-Key is required and becomes the allocation's identity.

createCreditNoteRefund.description: Creates a refund against an issued credit note on a paid invoice. Omit amount_money to refund all available credit. Refunds use the source invoice's original payments and do not reopen its balance. Idempotency-Key is required and retained for the lifetime of the refund command, scoped to merchant, environment, credit note, and key. Reusing it with another request conflicts. Recover a lost response by listing this note's refunds with idempotency_key. A failed remainder can be requested with a new key after its outcome is definitive.

createCustomDomain.description: Configures a checkout or customer account hostname in this environment. Remove an existing hostname of the same type before creating its replacement. If the create response is lost and a retry returns 500 IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, keep the original Idempotency-Key. List domains with GET /v1/custom-domains?type=customer_account and GET /v1/custom-domains?type=customer_account&status=archived, using type=checkout for both requests if that was the original type. Follow pagination and inspect current and archived domains for the requested hostname; use a matching domain's custom_domain_id to retrieve its current state. Do not switch keys or wait for key retention to expire to create again. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome is still unclear.

createCustomer.description: Creates a customer for the authenticated merchant.

createCustomerAccessLink.description: Signs the buyer in to your Flint-hosted customer account as this customer. Works for 15 minutes and one open. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same Idempotency-Key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. Send no request body or an empty object ({}). Requires customers.sessions.write. Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this customer's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its open. Without an Idempotency-Key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with X-Request-Id before sending a new request.

createCustomerAddress.description: Creates a stable saved address. The address becomes a default only when the request sets is_default_billing or is_default_shipping, or later through set-default, including the customer's first address. A saved default becomes the customer's effective address for the corresponding role.

createCustomerDeletionRequest.description: Creates a deletion request for merchant review, or returns the customer's open request unchanged. No deletion work starts until approval.

createCustomerSession.description: Mints a server-side, customer-scoped credential after the merchant has authenticated the buyer. Keep secret and refresh_token on your server. For hosted sign-in, create a customer access link instead.

createCustomerVerification.description: Sends a Flint verification code to the customer's current email for linking guest purchases. A customer without an email returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. Set purpose to link_guest_purchases; email is the only channel and the default. Confirm the code before linking purchases. To prove an email inside a checkout, use POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications.

createDeliveryLocationSet.description: Delivery location sets pin reusable sets of Locations for allocation or buyer pickup. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts active.

createDeliveryMethod.description: Delivery methods combine eligibility, pricing, schedules, estimates, tax treatment, and execution behavior. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. Omit status to start inactive.

createDeliveryPreview.description: Computes delivery options with mode delivery_options or up to 25 pickup locations with mode pickup_locations. Creates no resource, holds no inventory, and does not change the current selection. Pickup locations are nearest first when a buyer location is provided. Merchant callers receive diagnostics. Checkout credentials may use only pickup_locations for their own checkout session.

createDeliveryProfile.description: Delivery profiles define reusable delivery rules assigned to catalog obligations. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts active.

createDeliveryRateCallback.description: Delivery callback endpoints pin shared outbound callback transport configuration. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts inactive.

createDeliveryRateCallbackTestDelivery.description: Sends a signed delivery rate callback with synthetic non-PII data and returns a safe result. The Idempotency-Key fingerprint includes the delivery_rate_callback_id path value and request body. A retry replays the original result even after the callback changes or is archived.

createDeliveryZone.description: Delivery zones define versioned geographic eligibility. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts active.

createDemoSession.description: Creates a temporary demo sandbox and returns a short-lived test API key. The secret key is displayed only at creation time and for a short idempotent retry window. Omit template to use quickstart; an explicit empty or unsupported value is invalid.

createDeveloperPartnerApp.description: Creates a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. Use a developer setup session during setup or a normal external API key afterward.

createDeveloperSandbox.description: Creates a new empty test sandbox for the current merchant. Send `issue_test_key: true` to also receive a test key bound to it.

createDevice.description: Creates a device. If an active device already has the hardware_fingerprint, returns 409 ALREADY_EXISTS with reason hardware_fingerprint_already_exists and changes nothing. The details[0].current_resource field names the existing device.

createDiscountPreview.description: Evaluates promotion outcomes for an order without changing it. Returns the complete result inside data, without creating a resource or requiring an idempotency key. Use `promotion_id` for server-side apply flows where you already know the promotion, including code-gated promotions, which then apply without a code and count only toward the promotion's `max_uses`. Checkout credentials must use `promotion_code`. The response includes applied, skipped, and single-threshold available promotion candidates.

createDisputeResponseSession.description: Creates a browser session for responding to or viewing a dispute with Stripe Connect. Requires payments.disputes.write. Allowed for closed disputes; bank returns cannot be contested. Pass the returned payment to setPayment or the React payment prop. Each completed retry creates a fresh single-use client secret. Keep your API key on your server.

createFeedbackReport.description: Stores one immutable occurrence of Flint feedback. Use one report per root cause and include only the evidence needed to describe Flint's behavior.

createFile.description: Upload a local image to Flint. Create a file, PUT the bytes to upload.url with upload.method and every upload.headers value, then POST /v1/files/{file_id}/complete. The URL works for 15 minutes. Purpose requires its own write scope: product and product_variant use commerce.products.write; bundle uses commerce.bundles.write; payment_link uses checkouts.payment_links.write; subscription_plan uses commerce.subscription_plans.write; merchant_logo and merchant_icon use merchants.profile.write. Logo and icon files are merchant-wide; all other purposes belong to the authenticated environment. Partner installs can upload commerce images but cannot upload merchant_logo or merchant_icon: those purposes return INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE with scope_requirement because merchants.profile.write is not grantable to installs. Idempotency is scoped to merchant, credential, environment, and route. A replay returns the original upload target without extending its expiry. After a lost response, retry with the same Idempotency-Key or create another file. Each upload URL expires 15 minutes after creation.

createFulfillment.description: Creates a fulfillment for the specified quantities on a paid order. Use this when you manage fulfillment outside checkout; checkout creates fulfillments for the buyer's delivery selections. Returns ORDER_NOT_FULFILLABLE when the order is not paid. See the [fulfillment guide](/guides/fulfillment).

createFulfillmentEvent.description: Records an observational event for a fulfillment or one of its shipments or packages. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

createGiftCard.description: Creates a merchant-issued USD gift card with optional paid funding or imported opening value. External funding is merchant-attested and does not collect a payment. The full code is returned only by issuance or code replacement and their authorized retries for 24 hours, while that code remains current. Replacing a code ends recovery of that code. Financial command identity is retained for the lifetime of the ledger.

createGiftCardFundingDisposition.description: Accepts a confirmed funding dispute loss and honors all gift card value funded by that payment, including value restored to replacement cards. Records the dispute amount, original gift card consideration, honored value and preserved reservations. Clears only this dispute restriction; balances, unrelated restrictions and unresolved payment reservations remain intact. Requires gift card adjustment authority and a durable Idempotency-Key.

createGiftCardLoad.description: Adds positive value with separately recorded consideration and funding provenance. Limits apply to externally funded value and imports as well as Flint-funded sales. Loading a pending card activates it; loading a frozen card does not remove its restrictions. expected_version fences the gift card version.

createGiftCardNotification.description: Creates a recipient email notification, immediately or up to 90 days from now. A resend creates a new resource with resend_of_notification_id. An unconfirmed send must be resolved before another send is requested. Sending does not change gift card value or order fulfillment.

createGiftCardRedemption.description: Posts an exact amount automatically or reserves it for one full manual capture. Insufficient funds are rejected without a partial debit. Manual reservations default to 15 minutes and may be bounded up to 24 hours. External integrations coordinate and compensate their other tenders themselves. expected_version fences the version of the card in gift_card_id.

createInventoryAdjustment.description: Record a stock change by what happened: stock received, returned, sold, stolen, lost, or moved between conditions, or an absolute count or correction. Flint computes the change against the current level. Returns the adjustment, its movement IDs, and the resulting level for every level touched. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Create an allocation policy with its routing configuration. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInventoryCount.description: Open a physical count for selected inventory items at one Location. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInventoryItem.description: Create an inventory item. SKU and barcode are searchable attributes, not identity: they are not required to be unique. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInventoryReceipt.description: Record a completed inventory receipt and disposition. This is a downstream stock effect, not the customer Return lifecycle. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInventoryReservation.description: Route standalone merchant demand and hold stock in one atomic command. A hold defaults to 15 minutes and can last up to 24 hours. Set expires_at when creating it or PATCH the reservation to change its deadline. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInventoryTransfer.description: Create a planned stock transfer between two Locations. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

createInvoice.description: Creates an invoice draft from exactly one source: order_id for an order-backed invoice, or quick_pay for an invoice with a new backing order. Include issue to issue it immediately, using merchant_default delivery when issue is empty. Idempotency-Key is required for every request because issuing an automatic-collection invoice can charge the buyer. Replays preserve the original invoice result and recover its current public_url only within 24 hours of the original request; later replays omit public_url. Use GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id} for the current invoice. If Flint returns IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, contact Flint support with the original Idempotency-Key and request ID. Never retry with a new key.

createInvoiceLateFee.description: Assesses the frozen late fee policy once per invoice or overdue schedule entry. The issued document remains unchanged.

createInvoiceManualPayment.description: Applies an offline/manual payment to an issued invoice. Recording is rejected with INVOICE_PAYMENT_RESOLVING while an online payment is still resolving; an idle open checkout does not block. A payment that clears the balance invalidates the open checkout session. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

createInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Create invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant.

createLocation.description: Create a Location. Sending inventory_allocation_enabled also requires commerce.inventory_locations.write. Omitted inventory_allocation_enabled defaults to false. Every Location can hold stock. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body.

createMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Saves an address for the buyer. The address becomes a default only when the request sets is_default_billing or is_default_shipping, or later through set-default, including the buyer's first address. A default address is also the billing or shipping address on the buyer's customer profile.

createMeDeletionRequest.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Asks the store to delete the buyer's account, or returns the request already pending. The store approves or rejects it. Deletion anonymizes the customer: orders, payments, and refunds stay without the buyer's identity.

createMeEmailChangeRequest.description: Sends short-lived confirmation codes to the current and new email addresses. If the account has no current email, only the new address must be confirmed. The customer email does not change until confirmation succeeds. Limited to three attempts per 15 minutes, including attempts rejected because the email is already used. A rejected attempt keeps any pending email change request. Over the limit, the request returns 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with Retry-After set to the whole seconds until the oldest counted attempt leaves the window, at least 1.

createMeFlintWalletStoreSetup.description: Records the buyer's consent to save an independent store copy for off-session payments, including subscriptions. Call only after the buyer agrees. Requires a live email-code buyer login and an enabled Flint wallet at a Flint-hosted store account. Supply an id from listMeFlintWalletPaymentMethods. Confirm client_setup with Stripe.js confirmSetup, then poll GET /v1/me/payment-methods/{payment_method_id} until active before changing a subscription through /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/payment-method. Setup may request authentication. Removing the platform card or revoking store consent blocks the copy immediately. Idempotency-Key is optional and scoped to the store, customer, card handle, and key. Responses are retained for 24 hours. After a copy is revoked, retries with any key bound to that copy are refused. Get new consent and use a new key to create another copy. Retry a lost response with the same key. Concurrent requests for the same card at this store share one copy and setup. A failed off-session charge can still require the buyer to return through the existing card-update link. Accept an empty body or {}.

createMeInvoiceCheckoutSession.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the current open invoice checkout session and aligned card attempt when they still match the invoice balance and collection run. A newly created session and attempt share the fixed expiration of the active invoice public-link generation. Unexpired sessions are reused regardless of remaining lifetime; active payment work returns a resolving conflict instead of creating competing collection. When the invoice's order has items to deliver, a new session offers the delivery methods in settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids, and the request fails with a validation error when those methods cannot deliver every item. return_url sets where the checkout sends the buyer after paying. A reused session takes a new return_url only until a payment starts on it, and keeps the one it has after that.

createMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Starts saving a payment method for the buyer and returns the client setup to confirm in the browser. The payment method is pending until setup succeeds.

createMerchantAccountSession.description: Creates an embedded browser handoff for one or more allowlisted account components. An onboarding session is limited to the merchant's default sandbox unless sandbox_id in the JSON body names another sandbox of the same merchant. Live onboarding requires a live API key. A completed retry with the same Idempotency-Key creates a fresh launch session instead of replaying a prior client secret.

createMeReturn.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Requests a Return for one of the buyer's orders. An active return policy must cover each line and leave the requested quantity eligible, or the request fails with 409 RETURN_SELF_SERVICE_NOT_ALLOWED. Check can_buyer_request with POST /v1/me/return-previews first. The buyer's reason must be active and apply to the line, and a policy that sends the request to review leaves the Return waiting for the store's decision.

createMeReturnPreview.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Preview return eligibility or resolution amounts without creating a Return or reserving quantity. Set mode to eligibility or resolution and send the matching input object.

createMeReturnResolutionCheckoutSession.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Create or reuse a hosted or embedded checkout session for the buyer's balance on a replacement order linked to this return resolution. Returns 200 when reusing an existing session and 201 when creating one. Omit surface to use hosted. The same surface reuses the open session; changing surface replaces an idle session and is refused while a payment is in progress. Use redirects to set where the buyer goes after paying or canceling. The return_url field is an alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout and must be an address of the merchant's customer account. A reused session takes a new success destination only until a payment starts, then keeps its existing destination.

createMeSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Starts one manual collection attempt on a past-due subscription. Send no body, or an empty object. Poll the returned retry for the outcome. While cancellation is scheduled, a new buyer retry returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason cancellation_scheduled and current_status past_due. First use POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/reactivate to keep the subscription; retry_payment becomes available again if the other retry conditions allow it. Only one retry may be in progress at a time. Buyers can start a retry while fewer than 3 retries have been created for the current billing period, counting the store's retries too. subscription_card_update email-link sessions can start retries.

createMeSubscriptionPreview.description: Estimates a buyer's next subscription renewal, or lists delivery methods and rates for a proposed destination, without changing the subscription. next_renewal includes recurring promotions, shipping, and tax for the next charged cycle. Tax is null when no tax address is available; a tax service failure returns 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR. Requires a full buyer session. A preview does not reserve inventory or guarantee a future shipping rate.

createOnboardingAPIKey.description: Creates the first long-lived sandbox API key. An onboarding session is limited to the merchant's default sandbox unless sandbox_id in the JSON body names another sandbox of the same merchant. Live onboarding requires a live API key created in the dashboard.

createOrder.description: Creates an order for the authenticated merchant. For USD orders, an effective requested tip may be up to the larger of $1,000 or 100% of the post-discount merchandise subtotal.

createOrderAccessLink.description: Creates the link Flint's receipt email carries, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. It opens the order in your Flint-hosted customer account without a sign-in, and lets the buyer have the receipt sent again to the order's email. It works for 30 days or 10 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in to see the order. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same Idempotency-Key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it returns ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED, and for an order without a customer, ACCESS_LINK_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED. Send no request body or an empty object ({}). Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an Idempotency-Key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with X-Request-Id before sending a new request.

createOrderCharge.description: Adds a service charge, fee, or surcharge to an order.

createOrderLineItems.description: Adds one or more line items to an order.

createOrderPaymentIntent.description: Creates a payment intent owned by the order. Collect a payment source using payment_collection, then submit that source through payOrder. This route requires commerce.orders.write; standalone payment-intent routes require payments.payment_intents.write.

createOrganization.description: Creates a child organization within the caller's accessible organization hierarchy.

createPackage.description: Creates a package record under a shipment. Change package status with POST /v1/packages/{package_id}/transitions; this endpoint records package-level carrier, tracking, label, measurement, and external correlation fields. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

createPackageItem.description: Adds an order line quantity to a package. Total active package item quantities cannot exceed the parent fulfillment line-item quantity.

createPaymentIntent.description: Creates a standalone payment intent for the authenticated merchant and returns it flat in data with required payment_collection guidance. Create order-owned payment intents with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/payment-intents.

createPaymentLink.description: Creates a payment link for the authenticated merchant. Line items may use fixed prices, buyer-adjustable amounts, and buyer-adjustable quantities.

createPaymentMethod.description: Initiates saving a payment method and returns the client setup payload needed to complete setup on the frontend.

createPaymentMethodDomain.description: Registers one exact domain or subdomain for Apple Pay and Google Pay in the selected Flint environment, then validates its wallet readiness.

createPayout.description: Creates a payout from an available balance to an eligible payout destination. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

createProduct.description: Creates a product for the authenticated merchant.

createProductVariant.description: Create product variant. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

createPromotion.description: Creates a promotion for the authenticated merchant.

createPromotionCode.description: Creates a code for a code-gated promotion. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

createRefund.description: Creates a refund for an order, a payment intent, a captured gift card redemption, or a gift card load. Set refund_type to full for the full remaining refundable amount, amount for an explicit amount_money, or targets for named line items, charges, and taxes. To refund a gift card redemption made outside a Flint order, set refund_type to amount and send one tender_allocations entry per redemption, with no order_id. A created refund returns 201 even when processing fails; inspect status and failure_reason. A same-key replay returns the original refund without another money attempt. This is a financial operation.

createReport.description: Creates an idempotent asynchronous CSV report. interval_end_at may be at most the same local time 366 calendar days after interval_start_at in timezone, and must not be in the future. Poll the returned report until it succeeds or fails.

createReturn.description: Create a requested Return. Every line needs the return_reason_id of an active reason. With an API key, a Return that no policy matches stays available for merchant review rather than failing creation.

createReturnAccessLink.description: Creates the link Flint's email about a Return carries, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. It opens the Return and its order in your Flint-hosted customer account without a sign-in. Withdrawing the Return needs the buyer to sign in. It works for 30 days or 10 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in to see the Return. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same Idempotency-Key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it returns ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED, and for a Return whose order has no customer, ACCESS_LINK_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED. Send no request body or an empty object ({}). Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an Idempotency-Key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with X-Request-Id before sending a new request.

createReturnDisposition.description: Record an auditable merchandise disposition from either a receipt line or an inspection line. Read dispositions with `GET /v1/return-dispositions?return_id=` or expand `return_dispositions` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createReturnInspection.description: Record an immutable inspection observation. Corrections supersede an earlier inspection instead of editing physical history. Read inspections with `GET /v1/return-inspections?return_id=` or expand `return_inspections` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createReturnLineItem.description: Add a line item to a requested Return. The response is the updated Return, not the new line.

createReturnPolicy.description: Create a Return policy with its first revision. The policy ID is stable across revisions, and each published revision is immutable.

createReturnPolicyRevision.description: Publish a new immutable Return policy revision while preserving the stable policy identity. Send the policy's current version as expected_version to reject a concurrent policy edit or publish.

createReturnPreview.description: Preview return eligibility or resolution amounts without creating a Return or reserving quantity. Set mode to eligibility or resolution and send the matching input object.

createReturnReason.description: Create a merchant Return reason buyers can select. Buyer reasons are distinct from inspection findings, decline reasons, and Refund reasons. Flint handles and all existing merchant handles, including archived reasons, are reserved. A conflicting handle returns 409 ALREADY_EXISTS.

createReturnReceipt.description: Record an immutable merchandise receipt observation. Corrections supersede an earlier receipt instead of editing physical history. Read receipts with `GET /v1/return-receipts?return_id=` or expand `return_receipts` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createReturnResolution.description: Propose a buyer-value outcome for approved quantity. Creating a resolution reserves line value. Confirmation is what freezes it and starts its effects. Read resolutions with `GET /v1/return-resolutions?return_id=` or expand `return_resolutions` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createRiskList.description: Creates an empty list. Rules refer to it by alias, which can't be changed or reused, even after the list is archived. item_type decides how values are validated and compared.

createRiskListItems.description: Adds up to 500 values, each validated and normalized for the list's item_type. The additions array reports each value's outcome: values already on the list come back as existing, so a batch is safe to resend. Returns 201 when at least one value was added and 200 when none were. Payments see the change from the next attempt.

createRiskPreview.description: Validates a draft rule, or an existing rule by risk_rule_id, without saving anything. An invalid rule has is_valid: false and its problems in issues. The warnings array says how the change would affect evaluation. Requires risk.read. Rule content issues return 200 with is_valid false, every issue in order, analysis null, and empty warnings. Valid rules return analysis and any warnings. When risk_rule_id is omitted, action and predicate are required. Malformed requests return 400; a missing risk_rule_id resource returns 404. Proposing action or predicate changes to a system rule returns 409 RULE_RESERVED. List reference issues are included at the list_alias path. A new rule at the active-rule limit receives a risk_rule_limit_reached warning.

createRiskRule.description: Creates a rule that applies from the next payment attempt. Flint validates the predicate and checks every list before activating the rule. The rule is active unless you send status: inactive. An environment can have 100 active rules, counting Flint's defaults. To check a draft without saving it, use POST /v1/risk-previews.

createShipment.description: Creates a shipment execution record under a shipment-type fulfillment. A shipment groups one carrier leg. Create one package under it for each physical parcel, including single-parcel shipments.

createSubscription.description: Creates a subscription for the authenticated merchant.

createSubscriptionAccessLink.description: Creates a link to one subscription in your Flint-hosted customer account, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. Omit purpose or send subscription_view for read-only access without a sign-in. Send subscription_manage to also let the buyer cancel, pause, or undo a scheduled cancellation, subject to your store's policy and the subscription's state. subscription_manage requires commerce.subscriptions.write; subscription_view requires commerce.subscriptions.read. Neither purpose permits other subscription changes or access to another subscription. Both work for 14 days or 5 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same Idempotency-Key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it returns ACCESS_LINK_MERCHANT_HOSTED. Send no request body, an empty object ({}), or an optional purpose. Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an Idempotency-Key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with X-Request-Id before sending a new request.

createSubscriptionDeliveryMigration.description: Each subscription is previewed before its delivery method changes. Progress and per-subscription failures remain available after completion.

createSubscriptionLineItem.description: Adds a catalog variant or bundle to future subscription renewals. Current prices and delivery eligibility are checked before the line is saved. Already-created orders keep their lines.

createSubscriptionOffer.description: Create subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

createSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Starts one manual collection attempt on a past-due subscription. Send no body, or an empty object. Poll the returned retry for the outcome.

createSubscriptionPlan.description: Creates a subscription plan for the authenticated merchant.

createSubscriptionPreview.description: Estimates the next renewal or a plan change, or evaluates a proposed subscription, delivery destination, or delivery method update without saving changes. next_renewal returns current recurring promotions, shipping, and tax for the next charged cycle. plan_change uses the same checks and pricing as change-plan, including unused paid item credit for billing_starts now. Tax is null when no tax address is available; a tax service failure returns 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR. Malformed JSON, unknown fields and request-level problems (a missing or unsupported mode, fields that belong to another mode) return 400. In create mode, every problem with the proposed subscription is returned in errors with is_valid false, not only the first. A preview does not reserve inventory or guarantee a future shipping rate.

createWebhookDelivery.description: Creates a delivery for a retained event and an endpoint that currently subscribes to it, then attempts delivery now. A failed attempt starts the automatic retry schedule. Each event and endpoint pair can have only one delivery.

createWebhookEndpoint.description: Creates a webhook endpoint and returns the signing secret once.

createWebhookTestEvent.description: Creates and delivers a synthetic test webhook event to one active webhook endpoint. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

createWorkloadIdentity.description: Creates an active identity in the authenticated environment and validates issuer discovery. Dashboard callers creating live identities need fresh identity verification. Machine callers may grant only scopes they hold in this environment.

decideReturn.description: Record one decision for every requested line atomically, then open the Return. To defer a line, decline its quantity or remove it with DELETE /v1/returns/{return_id}/line-items/{return_line_item_id} and open a separate Return for it. Omit completion_mode to use the shared pinned policy mode, or automatic when none sets a mode; disagreeing policies require an explicit completion_mode. completion_blockers reports uncovered approved quantity as resolution_not_selected alongside blockers for unfinished resolutions. Start from each buildable pinned policy proposal or the no-policy defaults, replace every supplied decision field, fill release_timing, and validate the result. When an automatic refund can no longer run through the original payment's provider, the request fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; send automatic_resolution_type as null to resolve manually, or choose no_monetary_action.

decideReturnInspectionLineItem.description: Record the accept or reject outcome for inspected quantity. expected_version compares against the inspection version. Accepted quantity becomes dispositionable and satisfies after_inspection release timing.

declinePaymentReview.description: Declines the payment and closes the review with `closed_reason: declined`. Flint cancels an uncaptured authorization, or refunds the remaining captured amount (captured minus earlier refunds) to the original payment method with reason `fraudulent`. Returns `200` when the review is closed, or when the refund already failed and the review is `open` again with `last_resolution_failure` set. Returns `202` while the refund is processing; wait for `payment_review.closed` or `payment_review.reopened`.

deleteBundle.description: Archives a bundle and returns its final state. Returns the archived resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references. When expected_version is present, it is compared before the archived replay; a stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with current_version.

deleteCategory.description: Permanently deletes an unreferenced category and returns it with status deleted. Deleted categories cannot be retrieved or listed. Remove all product, bundle, promotion, and return configuration references before deleting.

deleteCheckoutSessionCurrentDeliverySele.description: Atomically clears a provisional selection, releases inventory, removes its charges, and recalculates order economics.

deleteCustomDomain.description: Archives the hostname and starts its redirect retention window. Repeating the request returns the archived domain unchanged.

deleteCustomerAddress.description: Deletes a saved address and moves any default designation to the newest remaining address.

deleteDeliveryLocationSet.description: Retires the delivery location set after checking current dependencies. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeliveryMethod.description: Retires the delivery method after checking current dependencies. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects. A method referenced by checkout.default_delivery_method_ids at merchant scope or by delivery_method_ids on an active or inactive payment link cannot be archived; the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking references. Remove the method from checkout.default_delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/settings or from the link's delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/payment-links/{payment_link_id}. Open checkout sessions keep their pinned revision and do not block retirement.

deleteDeliveryProfile.description: Retires the delivery profile after checking current dependencies. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeliveryRateCallback.description: Retires the delivery rate callback after checking current dependencies. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeliveryZone.description: Retires the delivery zone after checking current dependencies. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeveloperPartnerApp.description: Archives a partner app (soft delete). The app stays readable with status archived; it cannot be installed, exchange tokens, or receive events, and its client ID is never reused. Revoke every active install first; pending installs are revoked with the app. Delete the app’s webhook endpoints separately.

deleteDeveloperSandbox.description: Retires a non-default sandbox and frees its original name for reuse.

deleteDevice.description: Archives a device and releases its hardware_fingerprint for reuse. The archived device no longer returns hardware_fingerprint.

deleteInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Retire an allocation policy. The policy is archived: it stays readable by ID and appears in lists only when you filter by status archived.

deleteInventoryItem.description: Retire an inventory item. The item is archived: it stays readable by ID and appears in lists only when you filter by status archived.

deleteInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Retires an invoice payment term by setting its status to archived. A default payment term cannot be retired.

deleteLocation.description: Retire a Location. Preserves the archived resource for direct reads.

deleteMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Deletes one of the buyer's saved addresses. A default it held moves to the newest remaining address.

deleteMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Deletes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments. Returns the payment method with status archived, including when it was already archived.

deleteModifierGroup.description: Retire modifier group. Returns the archived resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references. When expected_version is present, it is compared before the archived replay; a stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with current_version.

deleteModifierSet.description: Retire modifier set. Returns the archived resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references. When expected_version is present, it is compared before the archived replay; a stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with current_version.

deleteOrderCharge.description: Removes a single service charge, fee, or surcharge from an order.

deleteOrderLineItem.description: Removes a single line item from an order.

deleteOrganization.description: Soft-deletes an active organization, reports status archived, and keeps it readable by ID when it has no active descendants or non-closed merchant links. Conflicts include up to 10 blocking_resources and the total blocking_resource_count. Current organization access and mutation permissions are checked before idempotent replay. Idempotency keys are scoped to the merchant, mode, environment, and organization.

deletePackageItem.description: Removes an order line quantity from a package while the package is still mutable.

deletePaymentMethod.description: Deletes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments. Returns the payment method with status archived, including when it was already archived.

deletePayoutDestination.description: Disables an eligible payout destination and returns its final state. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

deleteProduct.description: Archives a product and returns its final state. Returns the archived resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references. When expected_version is present, it is compared before the archived replay; a stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with current_version.

deleteProductVariant.description: Retire product variant. Returns the archived resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references. When expected_version is present, it is compared before the archived replay; a stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with current_version.

deletePromotion.description: Archives a promotion and returns the resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references.

deletePromotionCode.description: Archives a promotion code. The code remains readable with status archived. Returns the archived resource exactly as GET returns it. Repeating DELETE returns 200 without changing version or updated_at, sending a webhook, or checking references.

deleteReturnLineItem.description: Remove a line item from a requested Return. Send optional expected_version as one query parameter to fence against the parent Return version. The response is the updated Return.

deleteReturnPolicy.description: Retire a Return policy so it is no longer evaluated and no longer appears as an active choice.

deleteReturnReason.description: Retire a Return reason so buyers can no longer select it. Returns that already recorded it keep the frozen reason name. Flint reasons cannot be archived; set status to inactive instead. Archived merchant handles remain reserved.

deleteRiskList.description: Archives a list you created. Fails with 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE while an active rule names it. Archived lists can't be used by rules or edited.

deleteRiskListItem.description: Removes a value from a list permanently. Payments see the change from the next attempt.

deleteRiskRule.description: Archives a rule. It stops running at once and can't be changed or restored. Flint's default rules can't be archived; set them inactive instead.

deleteSubscriptionLineItem.description: Removes a line from future subscription renewals. The final line cannot be removed. Send expected_version as a query parameter to reject a concurrent change.

deleteSubscriptionOffer.description: Archive subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

deleteSubscriptionPlan.description: Permanently archives a subscription plan from active or inactive status. Returns RESOURCE_IN_USE while active subscriptions, active payment links, or open checkout sessions reference the plan. To stop selling a plan while keeping its subscribers, set status to inactive.

deleteWebhookEndpoint.description: Permanently deletes the webhook endpoint and returns it with status deleted. Its pending deliveries are suppressed. The endpoint cannot be retrieved afterward, and its past deliveries keep its webhook_endpoint_id.

deleteWorkloadIdentity.description: Soft-archives the identity and returns it with status archived. The identity remains readable by ID and cannot be reactivated. Repeating DELETE without a stale fence returns the archived identity without changing its version.

getAnalyticsOverview.description: Returns high-level merchant analytics for the requested half-open period.

getAPIKey.description: Returns external API key metadata. Secrets, internal keys, and demo-session keys are not returned.

getAPIRequestLog.description: Returns one request with redacted headers, the redacted request and response bodies for write routes that capture them, and a curl reproduction. Detail older than 14 days has no headers or bodies.

getBalanceTransaction.description: Returns one balance transaction by ID, with optional related order expansion.

getCheckoutSession.description: Returns a single checkout session by ID.

getCheckoutSessionCurrentDeliverySelecti.description: Returns the provisional selection or the order-level committed selection effective for this checkout.

getCheckoutSessionDeliveryQuote.description: Returns a delivery quote for this checkout session. Checkout credentials receive the buyer view.

getCheckoutSessionDeliverySelectionHisto.description: Returns one checkout selection with its economics, lifecycle events, and retention-aware private data. While the selection is selected, the tax on its delivery charges follows the order's tax.

getCreditNote.description: Returns one credit note with its lines, total, and the credit still available to allocate.

getCreditNoteAllocation.description: Returns one allocation. A non-null reversed_at means the credit was returned to the credit note and the invoice balance reopened.

getCreditNotePDF.description: Returns the credit note document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope. The PDF exists from issue onward and carries your branding, the credited lines, and the invoice it corrects.

getCustomDomain.description: Returns a custom domain, including archived domains.

getCustomer.description: Returns a single customer by ID.

getCustomerAddress.description: Returns one saved address owned by the customer.

getCustomerDeletionRequest.description: Returns the current status of a tracked deletion request.

getDeliveryLocationSet.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery location set.

getDeliveryMethod.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery method.

getDeliveryProfile.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery profile.

getDeliveryQuote.description: Returns a persisted delivery quote for diagnostics and recovery by its ID, using the same merchant view as the quote list.

getDeliveryRateCallback.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery rate callback.

getDeliveryRevocation.description: Returns one permanent delivery revocation and its estimated impact at creation time.

getDeliveryZone.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery zone.

getDeveloperAuthContext.description: Returns non-secret metadata for an API key or CLI OAuth access token, including its merchant, environment, sandbox binding, and granted scopes. CLI OAuth sessions include auth_type=oauth and a stable oauth_grant_id instead of api_key_id. Multi-context tokens also include oauth_session_id, context_id, and the context name. No additional API scope is required.

getDeveloperPartnerApp.description: Returns a single partner app owned by the authenticated merchant.

getDeveloperPartnerAppInstall.description: Returns a single install for the installing merchant or the partner app owner.

getDeveloperSandbox.description: Returns a single sandbox by ID.

getDevice.description: Returns a single device by ID.

getDispute.description: Returns one dispute by ID, with optional customer, order, and payment intent expansions.

getEffectiveSettings.description: Returns the authenticated merchant's settings for this environment with Flint's defaults filled in.

getFeedbackReport.description: Returns one immutable feedback report in the credential's merchant and environment.

getFile.description: Returns a file's current status without upload credentials. Purpose requires its own read scope: product and product_variant use commerce.products.read; bundle uses commerce.bundles.read; payment_link uses checkouts.payment_links.read; subscription_plan uses commerce.subscription_plans.read; merchant_logo and merchant_icon use merchants.profile.read. The matching write scope also grants read access. Dashboard sessions require the purpose's manage capability. Logo and icon files are merchant-wide; other files belong to the authenticated environment. Partner installs can read commerce files but cannot read merchant_logo or merchant_icon. Expired deadlines are reflected immediately. Only ready files include url, width, and height. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

getFraudWarning.description: Retrieves an early fraud warning. Expand `payment_intent` or `dispute` to include them.

getFulfillment.description: Retrieves a single fulfillment by ID.

getFulfillmentEvent.description: Retrieves one provider-neutral fulfillment event by ID.

getFulfillmentNotification.description: Retrieves one fulfillment notification audit record by ID.

getGiftCard.description: Retrieves the current gift card, including supported lifecycle actions and balance projections. A gift card ID does not authorize a buyer to spend it.

getGiftCardFundingDisposition.description: Retrieves a committed funding disposition within the authenticated merchant and environment.

getGiftCardLoad.description: Retrieves original value, consideration, funding provenance and remaining attributable value for one load.

getGiftCardNotification.description: Retrieves a notification and its sending outcome. Sent means the sending provider accepted the message; it does not mean the recipient read it.

getGiftCardRedemption.description: Retrieves requested, reserved, captured, refunded and remaining refundable value with the current reservation status.

getInventoryAdjustment.description: Retrieve an inventory adjustment and its lines by ID.

getInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Retrieve an allocation policy by ID, including archived policies.

getInventoryAllocationPolicyRevision.description: Retrieve the immutable routing configuration captured by one allocation policy revision.

getInventoryCount.description: Retrieve an inventory count and its saved observations by ID.

getInventoryItem.description: Retrieve an inventory item by ID, including archived items.

getInventoryLevel.description: Retrieve an inventory level's current quantities and version by ID.

getInventoryMovement.description: Retrieve an inventory movement and its stock changes by ID.

getInventoryReceipt.description: Retrieve a completed inventory receipt and its disposition lines by ID.

getInventoryReservation.description: Retrieve an inventory reservation and its lines by ID, including merchant and order owners.

getInventoryTransfer.description: Retrieve an inventory transfer, its lines, and supported_actions by ID.

getInvoice.description: Returns a single invoice by ID.

getInvoiceManualPayment.description: Returns one recorded or reversed manual payment for the invoice.

getInvoicePaymentAttempt.description: Returns one card or ACH collection attempt for the invoice.

getInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Returns one invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant.

getInvoicePDF.description: Downloads the merchant-authenticated PDF artifact generated from the invoice snapshot.

getMe.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the buyer's customer profile.

getMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's saved addresses.

getMeCreditNote.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice.
