The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one credit note with its lines, total, and the credit still available to allocate.

getMeCreditNotePDF.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the credit note document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope. The PDF exists from issue onward and carries your branding, the credited lines, and the invoice it corrects.

getMeDeletionRequest.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the status of one of the buyer's deletion requests.

getMeEmailPreferences.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Returns which of the merchant's optional email categories the customer's current email receives in the selected merchant environment. A category the buyer never changed is on. Email preferences exist only for a customer with an email: without one, the read answers 404 with CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED. Receipts and other transactional email always send.

getMeFulfillment.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's fulfillments.

getMeGiftCard.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code.

getMeInvoice.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's invoices. A draft invoice returns 404.

getMeInvoicePDF.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the invoice document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope.

getMeOrder.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's orders.

getMePackage.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's packages.

getMePayment.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's payments.

getMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's saved payment methods.

getMerchantBillingBalance.description: Returns what the merchant currently owes Flint and owns as account credit in one currency.

getMerchantBillingInvoice.description: Returns one invoice issued by Flint for the authenticated merchant environment.

getMeRefund.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's refunds.

getMeReturn.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's Returns.

getMeReturnResolution.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a buyer-visible Return resolution, including the amount the buyer needs to pay. Use the checkout_session action to pay its balance.

getMeShipment.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's shipments.

getMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's subscriptions. subscription_plan is always included without expand: the plan's current summary, or null when the subscription has no plan.

getMeSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Returns one durable manual subscription payment retry.

getOnboardingState.description: Returns the consolidated onboarding state machine, including the primary next step for agents or humans. This endpoint is read-only. An onboarding session is limited to the merchant's default sandbox unless the sandbox_id query parameter names another sandbox of the same merchant. Live onboarding requires a live API key.

getOpenAPISpec.description: Returns the Flint public OpenAPI document for tooling, schema inspection, and client generation.

getOrCreateInvoiceCheckoutSession.description: Returns the current open invoice checkout session and aligned card attempt when they still match the invoice balance and collection run. A newly created session and attempt share the fixed expiration of the active invoice public-link generation. Unexpired sessions are reused regardless of remaining lifetime; active payment work returns a resolving conflict instead of creating competing collection. When the invoice's order has items to deliver, a new session offers the delivery methods in settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids, and the request fails with a validation error when those methods cannot deliver every item. return_url sets where the checkout sends the buyer after paying. A reused session takes a new return_url only until a payment starts on it, and keeps the one it has after that.

getOrCreateReturnResolutionCheckoutSessi.description: Create or reuse a hosted or embedded checkout session for the buyer's balance on a replacement order linked to this return resolution. Returns 200 when reusing an existing session and 201 when creating one. Omit surface to use hosted. The same surface reuses the open session; changing surface replaces an idle session and is refused while a payment is in progress. Use redirects to set where the buyer goes after paying or canceling. The return_url field is an alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout and must be an address of the merchant's customer account. A reused session takes a new success destination only until a payment starts, then keeps its existing destination.

getOrder.description: Returns a single order by ID.

getOrderCurrentDeliverySelection.description: Returns the delivery selection committed to an order.

getOrderPaymentAttempt.description: Returns one durable payment attempt for the order. Checkout-session callers can read only attempts created by their own session.

getOrganization.description: Returns an accessible organization by ID. An inaccessible organization returns 404; an inaccessible parent requested through expand returns 403 FORBIDDEN with reason expansion_not_permitted.

getPackageItem.description: Retrieves one package item by ID.

getPaymentIntent.description: Returns a single payment intent by ID. Unverified fee fields are omitted; read the intent again later for verified fees. For a standalone payment intent in requires_action, call confirm with an empty body to retrieve current_payment_action.

getPaymentLink.description: Returns a single payment link by ID. With expand=sales_summary, includes gross paid totals and refunded totals per currency.

getPaymentLinkPublic.description: Returns the sanitized buyer-facing payment-link snapshot and a private resolution context for this browser operation.

getPaymentMethod.description: Returns a single payment method by ID.

getPaymentMethodDomain.description: Returns one environment-scoped payment method domain and its Apple Pay and Google Pay readiness.

getPaymentReview.description: Retrieves a payment review. Expand `payment_intent`, `order`, or `customer` to include them.

getPaymentVolumeTimeseries.description: Returns merchant payment volume buckets for the requested half-open period.

getPayout.description: Returns one payout by ID, with optional related payout and payout destination expansions.

getPayoutDestination.description: Returns one payout destination by ID.

getPayoutSettings.description: Returns payout settings that control default payout behavior for the authenticated merchant.

getProduct.description: Returns a single product by ID.

getPromotion.description: Returns a single promotion by ID.

getPromotionCode.description: Returns a single promotion code by promotion ID and code ID. Archived codes remain readable, including codes of an archived promotion. Returns 404 when the code does not exist or belongs to another promotion, merchant, or environment.

getRefund.description: Returns a single refund by ID.

getReport.description: Returns one report and its terminal download or failure details when available.

getReportDownload.description: Authorizes the stable Flint download URL and redirects to a short-lived private file URL.

getResourceTimeline.description: Returns summary-only API request, webhook event, webhook delivery attempt, and image mutation entries for a single public API resource. The caller must have developer.resource_timelines.read and the matching read scope for the requested resource type.

getReturn.description: Retrieve a Return with its line items, policy evaluation, financial summary, and completion blockers. Supports expand for the order, customer, receipts, inspections, dispositions, resolutions, shipments, and each line item's reason and fulfillment.

getReturnDisposition.description: Retrieve one disposition with its type, destination, quantity, status, and any linked inventory effect.

getReturnInspection.description: Retrieve one inspection with its line items, findings, and current or superseded observation status.

getReturnLineItem.description: Retrieve one Return line item, including its quantity counters and the reason the buyer selected.

getReturnPolicy.description: Retrieve one Return policy. Supports expand for current_revision.

getReturnPolicyRevision.description: Retrieve one immutable policy revision, including the exact rules a Return was evaluated against.

getReturnReason.description: Retrieve one Return reason with its handle, category handles, and status.

getReturnReceipt.description: Retrieve one merchandise receipt with its line items and its current or superseded observation status.

getReturnResolution.description: Retrieve one resolution with its amounts, adjustments, execution blockers, and linked refunds, payments, and replacement order. Supports expand for those links.

getRiskList.description: Retrieves a risk list. item_count is its current number of values.

getRiskListItem.description: Retrieves one value on a list.

getRiskRule.description: Retrieves a risk rule. The issues array lists anything that stops Flint from evaluating it.

getRiskRuleAttributes.description: Lists the attributes a predicate can read in this environment, with each one's value type, operators, and the stage it becomes available. An attribute with is_available: false can't be used yet. Payment intent metadata is also readable as payment_intent_metadata.{key}, which isn't listed.

getSettings.description: Returns the settings stored for the authenticated merchant in this environment.

getShipment.description: Retrieves one shipment execution record by ID.

getSubscription.description: Returns a single subscription by ID. A paid checkout session's credential can retrieve only the subscription created by its source order. Checkout credentials cannot expand related resources.

getSubscriptionAnalytics.description: Returns windowed subscription metrics plus current subscription snapshot metrics.

getSubscriptionDeliveryMigration.description: Each subscription is previewed before its delivery method changes. Progress and per-subscription failures remain available after completion.

getSubscriptionOffer.description: Get subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

getSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Returns one durable manual subscription payment retry.

getSubscriptionPlan.description: Returns a single subscription plan by ID.

getWebhookDelivery.description: Returns one endpoint delivery and its current retry state.

getWebhookEndpoint.description: Returns a single webhook endpoint by ID. The signing secret is omitted after creation.

getWebhookEvent.description: Returns a specific webhook event for the authenticated merchant.

getWorkloadIdentity.description: Returns an identity in the authenticated environment, including an archived identity.

grantOrganizationMembership.description: Sets the role of a user who already belongs to this organization or one of its parent organizations. Returns 201 when it adds a direct membership and 200 when it changes one. It can't add new people; any other user_id returns 404. Current organization access and mutation permissions are checked before idempotent replay. Idempotency keys are scoped to the merchant, mode, environment, and organization.

issueCreditNote.description: Issues a draft credit note and freezes its PDF. Provide allocation to issue and apply credit to its invoice atomically, or refund to initiate a linked refund on a paid invoice. Allocation and refund cannot be combined. Omit allocation.amount_money to apply the smaller of the credit available after issue and the invoice's outstanding balance. An explicit amount must be positive, use the invoice's currency, and fit both balances. The result includes credit_note_allocation when allocation is requested. Idempotency-Key is required and is retained for as long as the issue's effects exist, scoped to merchant, environment, credit note, and key. Reuse the key with the identical request to recover the original credit note and allocation. Recover an allocation after a lost response by listing this note's allocations with idempotency_key=issue:<issue key>. For refunds, list this note's refunds filtered by the original idempotency_key. A pending refund is accepted but has not completed. Without allocation or refund, issuance leaves the invoice balance unchanged. Issue validates the stored preview against current shared creditable pools. A fitting correction whose preview changed returns CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION with reason credit_note_creditable_value_changed: replace its existing corrections with PATCH using the current expected_version, review the recalculated amounts, and issue again. A correction exceeding the remaining pool returns CREDIT_NOTE_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CREDITABLE. Affected historical tax allocations return ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason credit_note_tax_reconciliation_required.

issueDeveloperSandboxTestKey.description: Creates a new test API key that is bound to the target sandbox.

issueInvoice.description: Issues the invoice, creates the buyer-access link, and uses the selected delivery mode. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

linkCustomerGuestPurchases.description: Links purchases with the verified email and no customer to the verification's customer in the same merchant environment. Purchases bound to another customer stay with that customer. The verification is single use; use the same Idempotency-Key to retry an uncertain result.

listAPIKeys.description: Returns merchant-bound external API key metadata. Internal keys, demo-session keys, and secrets are never returned.

listAPIRequestLogs.description: Returns request summaries, newest first. With developer.request_logs.read the list covers every caller in the credential's environment. With developer.request_logs.self.read it covers only the calling credential's requests. Headers, bodies and a reproduction are on the detail route.

listBalances.description: Returns the current balance snapshot grouped by currency for the authenticated merchant in the standard list envelope. All balances fit on one page, so next_page_token is omitted.

listBalanceTransactions.description: Returns a paginated ledger of balance-affecting transactions, including availability timing and related public resources.

listCheckoutSessions.description: Returns a paginated list of checkout sessions for the authenticated merchant.

listCreditNoteAllocations.description: Returns every allocation made from a credit note, including reversed ones. Filter by idempotency_key to find the allocation a given request produced.

listCreditNoteRefunds.description: Lists linked refunds, including failed attempts, newest first. Filter by idempotency_key to recover a refund after a lost response.

listCreditNotes.description: Returns credit notes for the authenticated merchant, newest first. Filter by invoice_id to see everything credited against one invoice.

listCustomDomains.description: Returns domains ordered by created_at descending, then custom_domain_id descending.

listCustomerAddresses.description: Lists the customer's saved addresses with billing and shipping default flags.

listCustomerDeletionRequests.description: Lists deletion requests across the selected merchant environment so a merchant can discover and review buyer-created requests.

listCustomers.description: Returns a paginated list of customers for the authenticated merchant. Without a status filter, returns active and deletion_processing customers; deleted customers appear only when the filter names deleted.

listDeliveryLocationSets.description: Returns delivery location sets in a stable, cursor-paginated order. Archived resources are excluded by default.

listDeliveryMethods.description: Returns delivery methods in a stable, cursor-paginated order. Archived resources are excluded by default.

listDeliveryProfiles.description: Returns delivery profiles in a stable, cursor-paginated order. Archived resources are excluded by default.

listDeliveryQuotes.description: Returns persisted delivery quote diagnostics in stable creation order.

listDeliveryRateCallbacks.description: Returns delivery rate callbacks in a stable, cursor-paginated order. Archived resources are excluded by default.

listDeliveryZones.description: Returns delivery zones in a stable, cursor-paginated order. Archived resources are excluded by default.

listDeveloperPartnerAppInstalls.description: Returns installs for a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant.

listDeveloperPartnerApps.description: Returns partner apps owned by the authenticated merchant.

listDeveloperPartnerInstalls.description: Lists partner app installs on the authenticated merchant, across live and test mode. Requires a live API key.

listDeveloperSandboxes.description: Returns the merchant's sandboxes. Flint guarantees a default test sandbox for every merchant. Use an onboarding session token during setup or a normal external API key afterward.

listDevices.description: Returns a paginated list of devices for the authenticated merchant.

listDisputes.description: Returns a paginated list of disputes for the authenticated merchant with optional payment, customer, status, reason, case type, action required, and timing filters. Defaults to created_at descending. The amount sort compares amount_money.amount in minor units. The evidence_due_at sort places disputes without deadlines last in either direction.

listFeedbackReports.description: Lists feedback reports in descending creation order for the credential's merchant and environment.

listFraudWarnings.description: Lists early fraud warnings that card networks reported on your payments, most recently reported first. Filter with `is_actionable=true` to find warnings a full refund can still resolve before a dispute.

listFulfillmentEvents.description: Lists provider-neutral fulfillment events. Results default to received_at descending, with fulfillment_event_id descending as the tiebreaker. sort_direction applies to both the selected timestamp and the ID tiebreaker.

listFulfillmentNotifications.description: Returns persisted fulfillment notification audit records. Results default to newest created first.

listFulfillments.description: Returns a paginated list of fulfillments. Results default to created_at descending, with fulfillment_id descending as the tiebreaker. scheduled_start_at uses the service scheduled start or the start of the pickup, local delivery, or shipment window. For scheduled_start_at and terminal_at, null values sort first ascending and last descending.

listGiftCardFundingDispositions.description: Lists funding dispositions in descending ID order within the authenticated merchant and environment. Filter by idempotency_key to recover a committed command.

listGiftCardLoads.description: Lists funding lots in descending ID order. Consideration may be null for imported balances whose original purchase price is unknown. The idempotency_key filter recovers a load after a lost command response.

listGiftCardNotifications.description: Lists recipient notification identities, schedules and delivery outcomes. No redemption codes or recipient access tokens are returned.

listGiftCardRedemptions.description: Lists reservations and captured redemptions in descending ID order. Retrieve by idempotency_key to recover an operation after a lost response.

listGiftCards.description: Lists gift cards in descending ID order within the authenticated merchant and environment. Reads include masked codes, posted balance, reserved value and available value. Purchased cards have no expiry or service fees.

listGiftCardTransactions.description: Lists immutable financial entries across the merchant in ascending merchant_sequence order. Per-card sequences and balance snapshots support reconciliation. Reservations and code replacement never create financial debits.

listInventoryAllocationPolicies.description: List allocation policies. Archived policies are excluded unless you filter by status archived.

listInventoryAllocationPolicyRevisions.description: List immutable revisions of an allocation policy, newest first by default.

listInventoryItems.description: List inventory items. Archived items are excluded unless you filter by status archived.

listInventoryLevels.description: List inventory levels. Send expand=inventory_item to render each level's inventory item inline, so a stock table needs no read per row. Filter by inventory_item_status to see only the levels behind items that can be sold. Levels are strongly consistent individually, but pages may reflect different committed instants.

listInventoryMovements.description: List inventory movements, oldest recorded first. Send expand=inventory_item to render each movement's inventory item inline, so a history table needs no read per row. Filter by idempotency_key to recover the movements a command produced. Send sort_direction=desc to read the newest movements first.

listInventoryReceipts.description: List completed inventory receipt effects. Use typed Return filters for reconciliation when the receipt was created by Returns.

listInventoryReservations.description: List inventory reservations in ascending inventory_reservation_id order. Omit owner_type to include merchant and order owners. owner_key matches merchant owners only.

listInvoiceActivities.description: Returns a read-only history of an invoice for timelines and debugging, newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological order. Read the invoice and the resources each row references for authoritative state.

listInvoiceDeliveryAttempts.description: Returns email delivery attempts for send and reminder actions.

listInvoiceManualPayments.description: Lists every manual payment, including reversed payments, ordered by received_at descending with invoice_manual_payment_id descending as the tiebreaker.

listInvoicePaymentAttempts.description: Lists card and ACH collection attempts for an invoice in reverse chronological order.

listInvoicePaymentTerms.description: Returns a paginated list of invoice payment terms for the authenticated merchant.

listInvoices.description: Returns a paginated list of invoices for the authenticated merchant.

listLocations.description: List Locations. inventory_allocation_enabled is always included and can be filtered with the Location read scope. The false filter includes Locations without an inventory allocation configuration.

listMeAddresses.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's saved addresses with their billing and shipping default flags.

listMeCreditNotes.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the credit notes issued against this invoice, newest first.

listMeDeletionRequests.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Lists the current buyer's deletion requests in the selected merchant environment, newest first by requested_at.

listMeFlintWalletPaymentMethods.description: Returns the current buyer's usable wallet cards in newest-first order. Each id is an opaque per-store handle. store_payment_method_id is null until this store holds a copy. Requires a customer session minted from a live email-code buyer login at a Flint-hosted store account, including a login narrowed to a custom domain. Email links, checkout sessions, grants, merchant-created sessions, and API keys receive 404. Live and sandbox wallets are isolated. The full card collection is returned in one page. Flint wallet support must be enabled.

listMeFulfillmentEvents.description: Lists fulfillment events for an order owned by the current buyer, ordered by occurred_at descending. Internal merchant fields are omitted. order_id is required.

listMeFulfillments.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists fulfillments for the buyer's orders, newest created first.

listMeGiftCards.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Lists valid saved cards by saved time then card ID, descending.

listMeGiftCardTransactions.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Lists the full anonymous balance-change history by per-card sequence, descending. Other holders' identities and order references are omitted.

listMeInvoices.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's invoices. Draft invoices are never returned.

listMeOrderActivities.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a read-only, human-readable history log for an order. Use it to render timelines and debug what happened, not as a source of truth, ledger, or webhook replacement. Read the owning resource for authoritative state: the order for balances and status, the payment for payment state, the refund for refund outcomes, and the checkout session for checkout state. Do not sum balance_delta_money to compute an order balance. Informational rows such as payment_failed, refund_failed, and checkout_session_expired have a zero balance delta. The default order is newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological timeline rendering. A typical chronological log might show created, payment_failed, payment, refund, then refund_failed; each row gives one reference to click through for the authoritative resource.

listMeOrders.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's orders.

listMePackages.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists packages in the buyer's shipments, newest created first.

listMePaymentMethods.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists payment methods in every status except archived, newest first. Filter by status=active for the cards you can charge. Filter by usage off_session to list the payment methods a subscription, automatic invoice, or default payment method can use.

listMePayments.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's payments.

listMerchantBillingBalances.description: Returns what the merchant currently owes Flint and owns as account credit by currency. All balances fit on one page, so next_page_token is omitted.

listMerchantBillingEntries.description: Returns immutable merchant billing entries for the authenticated merchant environment, newest occurred_at first. Entries in the same second are ordered by type rank, then merchant_billing_entry_id; all three keys are descending. Type ranks are 10 for event_fee, custom_domain, and invoice; 20 for correction; 30 for credit_issued; 40 for credit_applied and credit_refunded; 50 for collection and custom_domain_collection; and 60 for collection_reversal and write_off. An entry can be recorded after entries that occurred later, such as a collection whose bank outcome arrives late. To pick up new entries, filter on created_after. Re-reading the same entry always returns the same values. To export an interval, use merchant_billing_itemized_v1. It fails with data_unavailable when billing projections or membership history are inconsistent, collection outcome or balance transaction evidence is missing, or an entry is invalid. This list does not run the report interval preflights.

listMerchantBillingInvoices.description: Returns invoices issued by Flint for the authenticated merchant environment.

listMerchantPartnerAppInstalls.description: Lists partner app installs on the authenticated merchant, across live and test mode. Requires a live API key.

listMeRefunds.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's refunds.

listMeReturns.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's Returns. Filter by order, return number, reason, status, decision, merchandise, resolution, or creation and update time. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_id descending as the tiebreak. Use sort_direction to reverse the order.

listMeShipments.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists shipments for the buyer's orders and Returns, newest created first.

listMeSubscriptions.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Lists the buyer's subscriptions. Subscriptions without a next_billing_at never match next_billing_after or next_billing_before, and sort last with sort_by=next_billing_at in either direction. subscription_plan is always included without expand: the plan's current summary, or null when the subscription has no plan.

listOrderActivities.description: Returns a read-only, human-readable history log for an order. Use it to render timelines and debug what happened, not as a source of truth, ledger, or webhook replacement. Read the owning resource for authoritative state: the order for balances and status, the payment for payment state, the refund for refund outcomes, and the checkout session for checkout state. Do not sum balance_delta_money to compute an order balance. Informational rows such as payment_failed, refund_failed, and checkout_session_expired have a zero balance delta. The default order is newest first. Use sort_direction=asc for chronological timeline rendering. A typical chronological log might show created, payment_failed, payment, refund, then refund_failed; each row gives one reference to click through for the authoritative resource.

listOrderPaymentAttempts.description: Returns payment attempts for the order, newest first. Checkout-session callers see only attempts created by their own session.

listOrders.description: Returns a paginated list of orders for the authenticated merchant.

listOrganizationMemberships.description: Returns the direct memberships for an organization.

listOrganizations.description: Returns the organizations accessible to the caller, filtered to the authenticated merchant's organization subtree for external API keys. Pagination uses the last returned sort value and organization_id, so inserting or deleting earlier rows does not shift later pages. Reuse page_token with the same filters and sort; page_size may change.

listPackageItems.description: Lists order line quantities contained in packages.

listPackages.description: Lists package records, newest created first.

listPaymentIntentActivities.description: Returns a read-only, human-readable history for a payment intent. Read the payment intent or referenced resource for authoritative state; this log does not replace webhooks or a ledger. Results default to newest first, with payment_intent_activity_id breaking timestamp ties in the same direction. Use sort_direction=asc for a chronological timeline. Page tokens are bound to the payment intent, merchant, environment, activity_type filter, and sort direction.

listPaymentIntents.description: Returns a paginated list of payment intents for the authenticated merchant.

listPaymentLinks.description: Returns a paginated list of payment links for the authenticated merchant.

listPaymentMethodDomains.description: Returns payment method domains ordered by payment_method_domain_id ascending in the selected Flint environment. Page tokens are opaque, bind to the list parameters, and return a validation error when invalid or mismatched.

listPaymentMethods.description: Lists payment methods in every status except archived, newest first. Filter by status=active for the cards you can charge. Optionally filter to a customer. Filter by usage off_session to list the payment methods a subscription, automatic invoice, or default payment method can use.

listPaymentReviews.description: Lists payment reviews, most recently opened first. A review opens when a `review` rule matches a payment the bank approved. Every status is included unless you filter by `status`.

listPayoutDestinations.description: Returns a paginated list of payout destinations available to the authenticated merchant.

listPayouts.description: Returns a paginated list of payouts with optional filters for status, currency, destination, method, and timing.

listProducts.description: Returns a paginated list of products for the authenticated merchant.

listPromotionCodes.description: Returns a paginated list of promotion codes in every status, ordered by created_at descending, then promotion_code_id descending. Archived codes are excluded unless status=archived.

listPromotions.description: Returns a paginated list of promotions for the authenticated merchant.

listRefunds.description: Returns a paginated list of refunds for the authenticated merchant.

listReports.description: Lists reports newest first by created_at, with report_id descending as the tiebreak, using opaque pagination.

listReturnActivities.description: Read the merchant history of a Return for timelines and audit. Read the referenced resources for current state. Activities are newest first by default; use sort_direction=asc for chronological order. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_activity_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnDispositions.description: List merchandise dispositions. Omitting return_id lists dispositions across every Return for the merchant. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_disposition_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnInspections.description: List inspection observations. Omitting return_id lists inspections across every Return for the merchant. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_inspection_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnLineItems.description: List the line items on a Return with their quantity counters, eligibility, frozen display identity, and return value. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_line_item_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnPolicies.description: List Return policies with their status. Include the current revision with expand=current_revision. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_policy_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnPolicyRevisions.description: List every published revision of a Return policy. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_policy_revision_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnReasons.description: List Return reasons, including Flint-provided defaults and merchant-defined reasons. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_reason_id descending as the tiebreak. Flint reasons have a created_at of 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, so they follow your own.

listReturnReceipts.description: List merchandise receipts. Omitting return_id lists receipts across every Return for the merchant. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_receipt_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturnResolutions.description: List resolutions. Filter by corrects_return_resolution_id to retrieve the correction history for a resolution that already settled. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_resolution_id descending as the tiebreak.

listReturns.description: List Returns for the merchant, filtered by order, customer, status, decision, merchandise, resolution, or creation window. Filter by idempotency_key to recover a create whose response never arrived. Newest first: created_at descending, with return_id descending as the tiebreak. Set sort_direction to asc for oldest first, with return_id ascending as the tiebreak.

listRiskListItems.description: Lists a list's values, newest first.

listRiskLists.description: Lists risk lists, newest first, including Flint's default block lists. Archived lists appear only when status includes archived.

listRiskRules.description: Lists risk rules, newest first, including Flint's default rules. By default, includes active and inactive rules. Archived rules appear only when status includes archived. This isn't the order Flint evaluates them in.

listShipments.description: Lists shipment execution records, newest created first.

listSubscriptionDeliveryMigrationFailure.description: Each subscription is previewed before its delivery method changes. Progress and per-subscription failures remain available after completion.

listSubscriptionDeliveryMigrations.description: Each subscription is previewed before its delivery method changes. Progress and per-subscription failures remain available after completion.

listSubscriptionOffers.description: List subscription offers. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

listSubscriptionPaymentRetries.description: Returns a subscription's manual payment retries, newest first.

listSubscriptionPlans.description: Returns a paginated list of subscription plans for the authenticated merchant.

listSubscriptions.description: Returns a paginated list of subscriptions for the authenticated merchant. Subscriptions without a next_billing_at never match next_billing_after or next_billing_before, and sort last with sort_by=next_billing_at in either direction.

listWebhookDeliveries.description: Returns webhook deliveries, newest first (`created_at` descending, then `webhook_delivery_id`). Includes deliveries of synthetic test events.

listWebhookDeliveryAttempts.description: Returns the attempts recorded for a specific webhook delivery.

listWebhookEndpoints.description: Returns a page of webhook endpoints for the authenticated merchant.

listWebhookEvents.description: Returns recent canonical webhook events for the authenticated merchant.

listWebhookEventTypes.description: Returns every webhook event type you can use in enabled_events and event filters, with the event sources each type is valid for.

listWorkloadIdentities.description: Returns identities in the authenticated environment, ordered by created_at descending and workload_identity_id descending by default. Archived identities are excluded unless status includes archived.

lookupEmailPreferenceLink.description: Reads an emailed preference token without signing the buyer in. The merchant key must match the token's merchant and environment. Tokens belong in the request body and must stay on your backend.

lookupGiftCard.description: Evaluates a full bearer code in a request body. Codes contain 16 ASCII Crockford base32 characters, accept lowercase and hyphens, and normalize O to 0 and I/L to 1. Lookup is side-effect-free and never reserves funds. Unknown, other-merchant and unusable codes return the same error.

markInvoiceUncollectible.description: Closes the outstanding balance as a write-off and releases the order's invoice collection authority. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

pauseMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Pauses a subscription immediately, optionally for at least one billing cycle. A pause with a duration resumes automatically at scheduled_resume_at. Repeating the stored pause length returns the paused subscription; a different length returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason field_locked and param pause_duration_cycles and requires resuming first. A buyer's pause follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

pauseSubscription.description: Pauses a subscription immediately, optionally for at least one billing cycle. A pause with a duration resumes automatically at scheduled_resume_at. Repeating the stored pause length returns the paused subscription; a different length returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason field_locked and param pause_duration_cycles and requires resuming first. A buyer's pause follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

payOrder.description: Starts or resumes a payment attempt on the order. Set action to pay to charge the full outstanding balance, confirm_payment_intents to confirm order-owned payment intents, setup to save a newly collected token on a zero-balance order, or resume to continue an attempt after a pending client action. Each action accepts only its own fields. Only confirm_payment_intents accepts completion_behavior. A pay action without payment_source is valid only when the outstanding balance is zero. To continue a resumable attempt, send action: resume with order_payment_attempt_id and a new Idempotency-Key. An exact retry of the original request with its Idempotency-Key returns the stored response if the request completed, or recovers the same attempt if it was interrupted. Payment intents with manual capture return an active authorization instead of settling immediately. A replay preserves the original HTTP status and domain result. Client authority in order_payment_attempt.pending_actions is available only within 24 hours of the original request and while the matching current payment attempt has status requires_action. Otherwise pending_actions is empty. Read GET /v1/orders/{order_id}/payment-attempts/{order_payment_attempt_id} for the attempt's current state.

previewPartnerInstallAuthorization.description: Validates the install link inputs and returns the partner app metadata and requested permissions for the consent screen. Flint ignores unrecognized parameters.

processReturn.description: Record decisions, receipts, inspections, dispositions, and resolutions for an existing requested or open Return in one request. On a requested Return, send one decision for every requested line; missing decisions return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason status_not_reached. Omit completion_mode to use the shared pinned policy mode, or automatic when none sets a mode; disagreeing policies require an explicit completion_mode. On an open Return, omit decision and completion_mode to keep committed values, or send those values unchanged; changed values return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason field_locked. completion_blockers includes resolution_not_selected for any uncovered approved quantity alongside blockers for unfinished resolutions. Refunds, payments, replacement orders, and inventory updates complete asynchronously. expected_version is optional and checked only when sent. If the Return has changed since that version, the request fails with VERSION_CONFLICT. When an automatic refund can no longer run through the original payment's provider, the request fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; send automatic_resolution_type as null to resolve manually, or choose no_monetary_action. Requires Idempotency-Key and all three scopes: commerce.returns.write, commerce.returns.operations.write, and commerce.returns.resolutions.write.

reactivateMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Clears a pending cancellation without changing the current billing period. Alternatively, PATCH the subscription with cancel_at_period_end set to false. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

reactivateSubscription.description: Clears a pending cancellation without changing the current billing period. Alternatively, PATCH the subscription with cancel_at_period_end set to false. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

refreshCustomerSession.description: Rotates a customer session secret and refresh token without a merchant API key. Reusing a rotated refresh token revokes the session family. Send one fixed Idempotency-Key per session: Flint scopes the key to the refresh token, so concurrent refreshes replay the same pair. On IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS, retry the same key and token.

refreshMerchantAccountSession.description: Creates a fresh provider session from a signed launch token after rechecking the authenticated principal, merchant environment, account controller, and component grant. An onboarding session can refresh only sandbox launch tokens created by the same user with an onboarding session. The sandbox is pinned by the launch token, using the merchant's default sandbox unless sandbox_id named another sandbox of the same merchant at creation. Live onboarding requires a live API key, and refresh requires the same API key that created the launch token. A completed retry with the same Idempotency-Key creates a fresh launch session instead of replaying a prior client secret.

regenerateInvoicePublicLink.description: Revokes the current buyer-access link and all checkout credentials derived from it, then returns a new public_url. The current checkout session and its payment lineage are preserved. Returns 409 CUSTOMER_DELETION_PROCESSING if the customer is being deleted or was deleted. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

releaseReturnResolution.description: Release a confirmed resolution that is waiting on a manual release. Available only while action_reason is manual_release.

removeMeGiftCard.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Removes only this buyer's saved access without changing funds or other holders' access. A repeated removal without an idempotency key returns 404 because saved access is already absent. Reusing the same idempotency key replays the original removal snapshot without restoring saved access. Idempotency keys are scoped to the buyer, merchant, environment, and operation. A replay cannot restore removed or revoked saved access.

removeOrderDiscounts.description: Removes one or more pending applied discounts from an order. Redeemed or canceled discounts are settlement history and cannot be removed.

removeOrderGiftCard.description: Removes a selected gift card without moving value. The expected_version must still match the order version. Selections cannot change during an active payment attempt. Retry a lost response with the same Idempotency-Key to recover the original selection result.

removeOrganizationMembership.description: Removes a user's direct membership and returns it with status removed. A role the user holds in a parent organization still applies. The owner can't be removed. Current organization access and mutation permissions are checked before idempotent replay. Idempotency keys are scoped to the merchant, mode, environment, and organization.

renewMeSubscription.description: Charges the next renewal now, ships it when the subscription has delivery, and moves the next billing date forward by one interval. Available while the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, is not in a trial, and has no delivery hold or renewal in progress. The subscription's payment method must be active and allow off-session charges. Requires a full buyer session and Idempotency-Key. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. Retry with the same key to recover the same attempt. Returns the subscription, renewal order, and payment attempt with status 200, including when the payment is declined. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error for a failed payment.

renewSubscription.description: Charges the next renewal now, ships it when the subscription has delivery, and moves the next billing date forward by one interval. Available while the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, is not in a trial, and has no delivery hold or renewal in progress. The subscription's payment method must be active and allow off-session charges. Requires Idempotency-Key; retry with the same key to recover the same attempt. Returns the subscription, renewal order, and payment attempt with status 200, including when the payment is declined. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error for a failed payment.

reopenReturn.description: Reopen a completed Return to record late compensating facts. Reopening sets completion_mode to manual, so complete the Return again with /complete once completion_blockers is empty. Confirmed money movements are never edited backward, so a monetary fix is a new correction resolution.

repriceOrderDiscounts.description: Recalculates pending discounts and automatic promotions for a mutable order. The request body is optional. Send expected_version to reject a mutation based on an outdated order read.

resendWebhookDelivery.description: Sends the event to the delivery's endpoint now, including while automatic retries are pending. A failed resend doesn't change the automatic schedule.

resetDemoSession.description: Ends the active or provisioning demo session identified by demo_session_id for this client and provisions a fresh one. A client that lost its create response gets the current demo_session_id from the error on ACTIVE_DEMO_SESSION_EXISTS or DEMO_SESSION_SECRET_REPLAY_EXPIRED. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body replays the replacement before checking the current session, including its secret during the secret delivery window. After that window, the retry returns DEMO_SESSION_SECRET_REPLAY_EXPIRED. The daily cap applies only to fresh executions. Omit template to use quickstart; an explicit empty or unsupported value is invalid.

resetDeveloperSandbox.description: Clears a non-default sandbox and returns its replacement environment. The replacement has a new sandbox ID, retains the stable provider-account lineage, and requires newly issued test keys. The archived sandbox's `replaced_by_sandbox_id` names the replacement.

resolveCustomerDeletionRequest.description: Approves or rejects a pending deletion request. Approval returns processing while account data and buyer credentials are deleted asynchronously. A failed deletion can be approved again but cannot be rejected. Approval is blocked while the customer has non-canceled subscriptions or usable saved payment methods.

resolveOrderInventoryException.description: Marks a paid inventory failure as resolved after an operator has completed manual inventory remediation.

resolvePaymentLink.description: Creates a buyer checkout session from an active payment link. Catalog-backed modifier availability is frozen onto the checkout session and selected modifiers are resolved onto the backing order. For a retry after an uncertain response, reuse the original Idempotency-Key and resolution_context.

resumeMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Asks Flint to resume a paused subscription. Returns 202 while the subscription is still paused, with resume_requested_at set. Flint then makes it active, or past_due while an overdue period is collected, and sends subscription.resumed. If Flint can't resume it, it stays paused, resume_requested_at clears, and Flint sends subscription.updated. Any other status fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. To undo a scheduled cancellation, use reactivate.

resumeSubscription.description: Asks Flint to resume a paused subscription. Returns 202 while the subscription is still paused, with resume_requested_at set. Flint then makes it active, or past_due while an overdue period is collected, and sends subscription.resumed. If Flint can't resume it, it stays paused, resume_requested_at clears, and Flint sends subscription.updated. Any other status fails with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. To undo a scheduled cancellation, use reactivate.

retryReturnDisposition.description: Retry a failed disposition with the same immutable intent. Disposition and effect identities are preserved, so a retry does not move stock twice.

retryReturnResolution.description: Retry a failed resolution. For gift_card_refund_destination_required, send gift_card_refund_destination: new_gift_card to persist the destination before starting the new attempt. The override is accepted for refund, exchange, and corrections of resolutions other than store_credit. A new attempt starts, historical payment and refund IDs stay on the resolution, and a late event from an earlier attempt cannot settle the new attempt. Fails with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, with the line's current_status, when a Return line the resolution covers is no longer approved, such as after it was canceled, and with RETURN_VALUE_EXCEEDED when an approved line no longer has the quantity the resolution covers. Retry is available only when failure_code allows it, and supported_actions includes retry in that case. A failure that retry cannot fix returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; cancel the resolution instead.

reverseCreditNoteAllocation.description: Reverses an allocation and reopens that much of the invoice balance. The original allocation keeps its row and gains reversed_at, so the history stays append-only. Reversing the allocation that closed an invoice moves it from credited back to open or partially_paid.

reverseInvoiceManualPayment.description: Reverses the named manual payment in full and returns its amount to the invoice balance. To correct an amount, reverse the payment and record the correct payment. Retries with the same Idempotency-Key replay the result; retries without a key return 409 once the payment is reversed.

revokeAPIKey.description: Permanently revokes an external API key and returns metadata with status revoked.

revokeCustomerSession.description: Revokes one customer session in the selected merchant environment. This does not revoke an independent Flint Account buyer session.

revokeCustomerSessions.description: Revokes every customer session for one customer in the selected merchant environment. Flint Account buyer sessions remain independent.

revokeDeliveryDependency.description: Permanently fences one exact method, endpoint, signing key, revision, or Location geography version. Issued quotes are revoked immediately. Current selections are released the next time they are read. Stable method and callback-endpoint targets require expected_version so a concurrent publication cannot broaden the revocation.

revokeDeveloperPartnerAppInstall.description: The installing merchant or partner app owner can revoke an install and all of its environment grants.

revokeDeveloperPartnerEnvironmentGrant.description: The installing merchant or partner app owner can revoke a single test or live environment grant for an install.

revokeMerchantPartnerAppInstall.description: Disconnects a partner app from the authenticated merchant: revokes the install, its environment grants and its refresh tokens. The app is sent partner_app_install.revoked with revoked_by: merchant. Revoking a revoked install returns it unchanged. To reconnect, install the app again.

revokeMeSession.description: Signs out the current customer session using its current server-held secret, including after expiry, after revocation, or after its parent buyer session or grant ended. Repeating the call preserves revoked_at. A secret rotated away by refresh is invalid. Flint Account buyer sessions remain independent.

rotateDeliveryRateCallbackSigningKey.description: Rotates the endpoint signing secret, accepts both keys for one hour, and returns the new secret once.

rotateDeveloperPartnerAppSecret.description: Issues a new client secret, returned once. The previous secret keeps working until previous_secret_expires_at: 24 hours by default, or the time in expire_previous_secret_at, up to 7 days. Send a time at or before now to stop the previous secret immediately, for example when it leaked. Rotating again during an overlap ends the older secret at once.

rotateGiftCardCode.description: Invalidates the old bearer credential and generates a new code for the same gift card. Balances, funding, reservations and refund history are preserved. Requires commerce.gift_cards.secrets.write. Include notification to send the new private recipient link. Retired links cannot open the current code. The new full code is available in this response and authorized retries only within 24 hours, while that code remains current. expected_version fences the gift card version.

rotateWebhookEndpointSecret.description: Issues a new signing secret, returned once. The replaced secret keeps signing deliveries until previous_secret_expires_at: 24 hours by default, or expire_previous_secret_at, up to 7 days. Send a time at or before now to stop the replaced secret immediately, for example when it leaked. Rotating again during an overlap ends the older secret at once.

saveMeGiftCard.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code. Idempotency keys are scoped to the buyer, merchant, environment, and operation. A replay cannot restore removed or revoked saved access.

sendInvoiceReminder.description: Attempts a reminder email for an already issued collectible invoice. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key. Accepts an empty body or {}.

sendMeOrderReceipt.description: Queues a receipt email for one of your paid orders to the order's email. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and normalized recipient.

sendOrderReceipt.description: Queues a receipt for a paid order, including gift card payments and settled payments, and returns the order unchanged. Send email to choose a recipient, or omit it to use the order's email. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and normalized recipient. Checkout credentials can send only to the address on file. If no address is on file, checkout credentials can send to at most three distinct addresses over the order's lifetime. Receipts sent for this order through this route count toward this limit, including failed deliveries and receipts sent with a secret API key. Merchant callers can choose any address.

sendPaymentIntentReceipt.description: Queues a receipt for a succeeded payment intent and returns the payment intent unchanged. For an order-owned payment intent, sends the order receipt. Once sent, the receipt appears as a receipt_sent payment intent activity. Send email to choose a recipient. Omit email to use the order's receipt address for an order-owned intent, or receipt_email then the customer's email for a standalone intent. The saved receipt email stays unchanged. Requires Flint-managed receipt delivery. Standalone sending is limited to once every five minutes per payment intent; order receipt sending is limited to once every five minutes per order and normalized recipient. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key to replay the result without sending again.

setDefaultCustomerAddress.description: Sets the address as the billing default, shipping default, or both and makes it the customer's effective address for each selected role.

setDefaultMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Makes one of the buyer's saved addresses the billing default, the shipping default, or both, and the matching address on the buyer's customer profile.

skipMeSubscriptionCycle.description: Skips the next renewal: nothing is charged or shipped for it, and the next billing date moves forward by one of the subscription's billing intervals while preserving billing_anchor_day, including in shorter months. Available when buyer skipping is enabled and the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, and is under the store's consecutive skip limit. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes.

skipSubscriptionCycle.description: Skips the next renewal: nothing is charged or shipped for it, and the next billing date moves forward by one of the subscription's billing intervals. A Flint-owned schedule keeps its billing_anchor_day, including when the skipped date falls in a shorter month. Available while the subscription is active, is not set to cancel at the end of its period, and has a next billing date.

startOnboarding.description: Starts the consolidated onboarding flow by emailing a short-lived verification code and returning a temporary verification token.

streamWebhookEvents.description: Streams canonical merchant webhook events created after the connection opens or after the supplied event ID. SSE event IDs are resumable webhook event IDs. Control records include ready, gap, withheld, and disconnect. Gap records indicate cursor_unavailable or payload_expired; withheld records hide payloads the caller cannot read. Backpressure emits disconnect with reason backpressure and resume_cursor identifying the last sent event, so clients can reconnect without losing events.

transitionFulfillment.description: Performs one action from the fulfillment's supported_actions. Every action accepts occurred_at for the transition time. For complete, occurred_at also records completion evidence. The hold and mark_no_show actions accept reason plus an optional reason_message note. Each action accepts only its action-specific fields. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

transitionGiftCard.description: Freezes spending, removes a merchant freeze, or closes a card after all value and restrictions are resolved. Unfreezing cannot remove unresolved funding-dispute restrictions. Freezing does not release accepted payment reservations. expected_version fences the gift card version.

transitionInventoryCount.description: Set action to apply or cancel an open physical count. The apply action sets inventory levels to the counted quantities and needs an observation on every line. The cancel action closes the count without changing stock. VERSION_CONFLICT on apply also covers a stale saved physical observation with no corresponding field in this request; these details omit param. Recount affected items and save the complete observations before applying again. Physical changes after observation require recounts, including at a trading location; holds and commitments alone do not invalidate observations. Stock-moving transitions return a result with inventory_count as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

transitionInventoryReservation.description: Set action to commit held quantity, consume committed quantity, or release held or committed quantity. Lines carry cumulative targets: resending targets already applied succeeds even after the reservation closes. supported_actions lists actions available for new changes. Stock-moving transitions return a result with inventory_reservation as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

transitionInventoryTransfer.description: Run one action from supported_actions using cumulative line targets. Send expected_version to reject the request if the transfer changed after you read it. The response includes the updated transfer and its inventory effects. Stock-moving transitions return a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

transitionPackage.description: Performs one action from the package's supported_actions. mark_shipped accepts carrier, service_code, tracking_number, and tracking_url; present fields replace tracking before the status change and shipped email in one transaction. Omitted tracking is unchanged and null is invalid. Other actions reject tracking fields. mark_shipped, mark_in_transit, and mark_out_for_delivery optionally set expected_delivery_at; send null to clear it. Delivery preserves the estimate as history. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

unsubscribeEmailPreferenceLink.description: Disables the email preference represented by an emailed token without signing the buyer in. Repeating the request keeps it disabled. The merchant key must match the token's merchant and environment.

updateAPIKey.description: Updates an API key's name, scopes, or expires_at. Expired keys can be updated, and a future expires_at reactivates one. A revoked key can't be updated. An API key caller may grant only scopes it holds and can manage only keys whose scopes it holds.

updateBundle.description: Update bundle. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updateCheckoutSession.description: Updates the mutable fields of a checkout session. A merchant credential can update metadata and external_reference_id, including after the session ends. Send external_reference_id as null to clear it, or metadata as null to clear all metadata. On a session with a subscription_plan_id, either credential can send subscription_terms with the buyer's billing interval and quantity while the session is open and no payment is in progress; a change reprices the signup order and releases the delivery selection. The session's own checkout credential can also send buyer_contact and timezone while the session is open. The buyer_contact field saves the email and phone the buyer entered; send a contact field as null to clear it. The timezone field records the buyer's IANA time zone, which Flint uses for times in the emails it sends the buyer. Saving the same values again changes nothing.

updateCreditNote.description: Updates draft credit note fields and corrections atomically. Omitted fields are unchanged, a null memo clears it, and line_items requires expected_version. Replacing lines recalculates their amounts from current remaining creditable pools. Scalar edits preserve stored line values. Issued and void credit notes are frozen.

updateCustomer.description: Applies a sparse update to a customer. Writing billing_address or shipping_address clears the corresponding saved-address default, so that field remains effective until another saved default is selected. Changing email requires customer_account.mode to be merchant_hosted; otherwise Flint returns 409 CUSTOMER_EMAIL_BUYER_MANAGED. If Flint cannot read the account settings, it returns a retryable 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE without changing the customer.

updateCustomerAddress.description: Applies a sparse update to a saved address. Updating a default address also updates the customer's effective address for that role.

updateDeliveryLocationSet.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeliveryMethod.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead. A method referenced by checkout.default_delivery_method_ids at merchant scope or by delivery_method_ids on an active or inactive payment link cannot be set inactive; the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking references. Remove the method from checkout.default_delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/settings or from the link's delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/payment-links/{payment_link_id}.

updateDeliveryProfile.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. Send is_default true to make this active profile the physical catalog default, together with any other mutable fields in one atomic update. Sending only is_default true for the current default leaves its version unchanged and emits no events. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeliveryRateCallback.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeliveryZone.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A change to pinned configuration publishes a new immutable revision and requires expected_version. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeveloperPartnerApp.description: Updates a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. Send only the fields to change. permission_manifest replaces the whole manifest and requires expected_version. An existing permission can drop scopes but not gain them; removing or narrowing a permission narrows existing environment grants immediately, and tokens issued with the removed scopes stop working. Adding a permission changes no install until the merchant authorizes again.

updateDevice.description: Applies a sparse update to a device. Send null to clear location_id or all metadata. The name field cannot be null. Archived devices return DEVICE_ARCHIVED with current_status archived.

updateFulfillment.description: Updates mutable fulfillment fields and fulfillment-specific details. Fulfillment line item allocation is set when the fulfillment is created. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updateGiftCard.description: Updates descriptive associations. Omitted fields are preserved; null clears external_reference_id or customer_id. This operation cannot change balances, currency, code or status. expected_version fences the gift card version.

updateInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Update policy fields, availability, or atomically replace its routing configuration. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent, and is required when replacing configuration. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

updateInventoryCount.description: Replace a count's complete observation set atomically. expected_version is required when replacing observations. Send every item exactly once with the count's current expected_version and each observation's required expected_physical_version. Read the level before physically counting; zero is valid for a missing level. Every assertion must match locked current stock or the whole save is refused. Preserve saved quantities and fences for unchanged lines. Recount affected items before supplying fresh fences, even when quantities are unchanged. Omitted condition quantities retain the matching level snapshot's values. occurred_at records provenance and does not reconstruct historical stock. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

updateInventoryItem.description: Update an inventory item. Accepts status active or inactive. Send sku or barcode as null to clear. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

updateInventoryLevel.description: Set one inventory level's safety_stock_quantity. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. The version changes on every quantity or claim change, including holds and commits, so read the level immediately before a PATCH. Returns the updated inventory level. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the relevant resource or inventory movement list.

updateInventoryReservation.description: Change the hold deadline of a reservation you created. The new expires_at must be after now and at most 24 hours from now, and can be earlier or later than the current one. A lapsed hold cannot be extended, and reservations Flint holds for orders cannot be changed. Committed and consumed quantity never expire.

updateInventoryTransfer.description: Update an open transfer's planning details. Sending lines replaces the owned collection atomically and requires expected_version. For metadata-only edits, expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Send external_reference_id: null to clear it.

updateInvoice.description: Updates mutable fields on a draft invoice. Null is rejected for cc_emails, collection, payment_due, schedule_entries, reminders_paused, and expected_version; omit them to leave them unchanged. Send [] to clear cc_emails or the authored schedule. After issue, the only writable field is reminders_paused, which pauses or resumes automatic reminders on an open or partially paid invoice.

updateInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Update invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant. Null is rejected for name, calculation, and expected_version; omit them to leave them unchanged. Null clears late_fee_policy or external_reference_id.

updateLocation.description: Update a Location's profile, availability, geography, and inventory allocation in one call. Sending inventory_allocation_enabled also requires commerce.inventory_locations.write. The version advances on every change. expected_version is optional and compared with version when sent. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body.

updateMe.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Updates the current buyer's name or phone. Manage billing and shipping addresses through /v1/me/addresses.

updateMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Changes the fields you send on one of the buyer's saved addresses. The address field replaces the whole postal address. Send null for phone or label to remove it. Changing a default address also changes the matching address on the buyer's customer profile.

updateMeEmailPreferences.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Turns the optional email categories in the body on or off for the customer's current email at this merchant in the selected merchant environment, and leaves the others as they are. The setting follows the email address, so it also covers guest checkouts with the same email. A customer without an email has no email preferences, and the change answers 404 with CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED.

updateMerchant.description: Applies a sparse update to the authenticated merchant's public business profile fields. The api_version field changes the merchant's live default and requires a live-mode API key or the live dashboard environment.

updateMeSubscription.description: Updates payment_method_id, cancel_at_period_end: false, delivery, billing interval and quantity when the matching buyer action is available. Send billing_interval and billing_interval_count together. Mixed changes commit atomically. A scoped card-update session may send only payment_method_id and expected_version. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes.
