updateMeSubscriptionLineItem.description: Swaps a subscription line to an offered variant for future renewals. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. The replacement must remain deliverable to the subscription destination.

updateModifierGroup.description: Update modifier group. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updateModifierSet.description: Update modifier set. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updateOrder.description: Applies a sparse update to mutable order fields such as customer_id, notes, metadata, tax, the delivery destination, and the requested tip. A request containing only metadata, internal_note, buyer_note, or external_reference_id, with optional expected_version, can update open, closed, paid, and invoice-locked orders without changing totals. Other merchant edits keep hosted and embedded checkout sessions open unless an edit closes or completes the order, which ends the session with order_mutated. Edits can also end invoice, return-resolution, and subscription-plan sessions with order_mutated. A session already past expires_at ends with expired before the edit is applied. These annotation updates are blocked while any order payment attempt remains non-terminal, including an authorization awaiting capture, or checkout payment work is still resolving. Requests combining annotations with other fields use the financial mutation rules for the entire request. Send requested_tip: null to clear the current requested tip. A merchant can correct a paid subscription signup or renewal destination before shipment by sending delivery_destination and the current order version as expected_version. The committed delivery methods must remain eligible, and shipping and tax totals must stay unchanged. ORDER_DELIVERY_DESTINATION_REPRICE_REQUIRED returns the reason and computed shipping and tax amounts when the correction would change the paid totals.

updateOrderCharge.description: Updates a single service charge, fee, or surcharge on an order.

updateOrderLineItem.description: Updates a single line item on an order. expected_version is the order version returned in data.version. Send gift_card_recipient and expected_version to replace or clear recipient delivery details before any purchase funding. Checkout credentials can update recipient details, modifiers, or a line subscription offer selection, each with expected_version. Set subscription to null to buy the line once.

updateOrganization.description: Applies a sparse update to an accessible active organization. Send at least one field; metadata: {} is a valid no-op patch. The name field cannot be null. Set parent_organization_id to null to clear the parent or metadata to null to clear all metadata. Current organization access and mutation permissions are checked before idempotent replay. Idempotency keys are scoped to the merchant, mode, environment, and organization.

updatePackage.description: Updates non-lifecycle package fields such as carrier, tracking, expected_delivery_at, label access, measurements, metadata, and caller-owned external references. Descriptive fields can be corrected until the package is voided, regardless of shipment or fulfillment status. Corrections never email the buyer. Package status cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

updatePackageItem.description: Updates a package item quantity or metadata while the package is still mutable.

updatePaymentIntent.description: Applies a sparse update while status is requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, or requires_capture. In processing, succeeded, canceled, or expired it returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress or terminal_status, with the status in error.details[].current_status. amount_money can change only while status is requires_payment_method and before the first confirmation attempt; after that, create a new payment intent. customer_id can change only while status is requires_payment_method, and receipt_email only while it is requires_payment_method or requires_confirmation. Send null to clear tip_money, external_reference_id, receipt_email, or all metadata; amount_money and customer_id cannot be cleared. Order-owned intents accept only metadata and external_reference_id; amount_money, tip_money, customer_id, and receipt_email return INVALID_REQUEST with one NOT_ALLOWED detail per field. This route doesn't attach a payment source: send the buyer's credential to the confirm route.

updatePaymentLink.description: Updates a payment link. To replace line items, custom fields, or delivery methods, send the complete array with `expected_version`.

updatePaymentMethodDomain.description: Sets the domain registration status. Activating the domain also validates Apple Pay and Google Pay readiness.

updatePayoutDestination.description: Updates mutable metadata and settings for a payout destination. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

updatePayoutSettings.description: Updates mutable payout settings for the authenticated merchant. Safe to retry with the same Idempotency-Key.

updateProduct.description: Applies a sparse update to product-parent fields. When category_handles is present, it replaces the full category list; send [] to clear it. Sellable price, SKU, and inventory live on variants. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updateProductVariant.description: Update product variant. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updatePromotion.description: Applies a sparse update to promotion fields. application_method, schedule, and exclusivity patch by subfield presence. Omitted fields retain stored values; null clears only nullable fields. Sending a different application_method.type replaces the effect while preserving omitted shared settings, including discounted_item_rules. Archived promotions cannot be changed. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updatePromotionCode.description: Applies a sparse update to a promotion code. An archived resource returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived. The error identifies the archived resource; a create under an archived parent identifies that parent.

updateReturn.description: Update caller-owned fields on a Return. Only external_reference_id and metadata are writable. Send optional expected_version to reject a stale Return version; every other change goes through a decision, operation, or resolution command.

updateReturnLineItem.description: Update a requested Return line item. Send null to clear buyer_note or requested_resolution_type. The response is the updated Return.

updateReturnPolicy.description: Update policy identity fields or set status to active or inactive. Rules live on revisions, so changing a window, fee, or scope means publishing a new revision.

updateReturnReason.description: Update a Return reason. Send null to clear description. A present category_handles array replaces the existing set. Set status to active or inactive to control availability. Flint reasons accept only status and expected_version; create your own reason to use different wording. Use DELETE to archive a merchant reason.

updateReturnResolution.description: Update a proposed resolution before confirmation. A present line_items, replacement_line_items, or adjustments array replaces that collection and requires expected_version.

updateRiskList.description: Renames a list you created. Flint's default lists can't be renamed.

updateRiskRule.description: Changes a rule's action, predicate, description, or status, and increases its version. Send expected_version to avoid overwriting another edit. Flint's default rules accept only status. Activating a rule validates it again.

updateSettings.description: Applies a sparse patch to merchant settings. See each field for how it is patched.

updateShipment.description: Updates shipment metadata and caller-owned external references. Shipment status is derived from package statuses and cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updateSubscription.description: Updates metadata, external_reference_id, payment_method_id, delivery, billing interval, quantity, or cancel_at_period_end: false to undo a scheduled cancellation. Send billing_interval and billing_interval_count together. A billing_schedule update must be the only mutable field. Delivery, cadence and quantity changes apply to future unpaid renewals. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. Schedule a cancellation with POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel, change the plan with /change-plan, and manage lines through the line-items collection.

updateSubscriptionBillingSchedule.description: Sets the next billing date, clears an external schedule while it awaits a date, or transfers schedule ownership. Moving a Flint-owned next_billing_at sets billing_anchor_day to its UTC day unless you send an explicit anchor. Transferring an external schedule to Flint with a next billing date follows the same rule. An unchanged date and owner preserve the anchor. The response carries the updated subscription. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

updateSubscriptionLineItem.description: Updates a subscription line for future renewals. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. Already-created orders keep their lines.

updateSubscriptionOffer.description: Update subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

updateSubscriptionPlan.description: Applies a sparse update to mutable subscription plan fields. Setting status to inactive returns RESOURCE_IN_USE while active payment links use the plan. Open checkout sessions do not block this change; buyers in those sessions are refused with PLAN_NOT_ACTIVE when they pay. Send line_items with expected_version to replace the plan's line items; omit line_items to keep them.

updateWebhookEndpoint.description: Updates the mutable fields on a webhook endpoint.

updateWorkloadIdentity.description: Updates mutable policy fields. expected_version is optional for scalar updates and required when claim_conditions or scopes is supplied. Arrays replace their entire value. Issuer and audience are immutable. Dashboard callers reactivating or widening live identities need fresh identity verification.

validateCustomDomain.description: Starts provider and DNS checks for this domain. Send no body or an empty JSON object. Checks are limited to once every 60 seconds per domain; rate limited responses include Retry-After.

verifyOnboardingEmail.description: Verifies the emailed code, provisions the Flint user and merchant if needed, and returns an onboarding session token. The token expires at onboarding_session_expires_at and cannot be refreshed. Verify the email again to get a new one.

verifyReturnReceiptLineItem.description: Establish the Return line identity for receipt quantity that arrived without one. expected_version compares against the receipt version. Unverified quantity counts toward no line and releases no release timing gate until it is verified.

voidCreditNote.description: Voids an issued credit note. Every allocation has to be reversed first. Void is terminal, and an invoice cannot be voided while an issued credit note stands against it.

voidInvoice.description: Voids an unpaid invoice so the associated order can be edited or collected again. An invoice with an issued credit note against it cannot be voided until that credit note is voided.

voidPackage.description: Voids a package before carrier handoff and appends a package timeline event. Voided package items no longer count against fulfillment package allocation capacity. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

voidShipment.description: Voids a shipment before carrier handoff and voids all child packages that have not shipped. The action appends timeline events for the shipment and affected packages. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

waiveInvoiceLateFee.description: Waives the unpaid remainder of an assessed late fee. Collected money is not refunded. The reason is visible only to the merchant.

waiveReturnLineItemInspection.description: Waive the inspection requirement on a Return line item so received quantity can be dispositioned and resolved without an inspection observation. Received quantity on a waived line satisfies after_inspection release timing.
